words.ex: The family is in a difficult plight after losing their home.
words.ex_cn: 这家人在失去家园后陷入了困境。
words.en: A plight is a difficult or adverse situation, especially one that is hard to escape. It can also refer to a solemn promise or pledge.

words.tr:
v. 遭遇；遇到；邂逅；
n. 遭遇；
words.ex: He encountered a bear while hiking in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他在森林里徒步时遭遇了一只熊。
words.en: If you encounter problems or difficulties, you experience them.

words.ex: The framework of the house is made of wood.
words.ex_cn: 房子的骨架是木制的。
words.en: A framework is a particular set of rules, ideas, or beliefs which you use in order to deal with problems or to decide what to do.

words.tr: n. 毁灭；引起毁灭的根源；
words.ex: The storm caused the destruction of the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴摧毁了村庄。
words.en: The act of destroying something, or the state of being destroyed.

words.ex: He makes frequent trips to the city.
words.ex_cn: 他经常去城市。
words.en: If something is frequent, it happens often.

words.ex: The lock uses a simple combination of three numbers.
words.ex_cn: 这个锁使用三个数字的简单组合。
words.en: A combination is a mixture of things or people that are combined.

words.ex: The equator divides the Earth into two halves.
words.ex_cn: 赤道将地球分为两半。
words.en: The equator is an imaginary line around the Earth, equally distant from the North Pole and the South Pole, dividing the Earth into the Northern Hemisphere and the Southern Hemisphere.

words.ex: I looked everywhere, but my keys are nowhere.
words.ex_cn: 我到处找了，但我的钥匙无处可寻。
words.en: In no place or state; not anywhere.

words.tr:
n. 节目；程序；
v. 编程；
words.ex: We watched a funny program on TV last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在电视上看了一个有趣的节目。
words.en: A program is a set of instructions that a computer follows in order to perform a particular task.

words.ex: The school changed its curriculum last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年学校更改了课程。
words.en: A curriculum is the subjects that are studied in a school, college, or university.

words.tr: v. 把…带错方向；“mislead”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He was misled by the false advertisement.
words.ex_cn: 他被虚假广告误导了。
words.en: If you say that someone has misled you, you mean that they have made you believe something which is not true, either by telling you a lie or by giving you a wrong idea or impression.

words.tr: adj. 中等的；次要的；第二的；
words.ex: He attends a secondary school in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他在城里上一所中学。
words.en: If you describe something as secondary, you mean that it is less important than something else.

words.ex: He uses stereoscopic glasses to see the 3D picture.
words.ex_cn: 他戴立体眼镜来看三维图片。
words.en: Relating to or denoting a process by which two photographs of the same object taken at slightly different angles are viewed together, creating an impression of depth and solidity.

words.ex: The intensities of the lights changed slowly.
words.ex_cn: 灯光的强度缓慢地变化。
words.en: The degree or extent of strength, force, or concentration.

words.ex: His repertoire includes singing, dancing, and acting.
words.ex_cn: 他的全部才能包括唱歌、跳舞和表演。
words.en: A repertoire is all the plays, songs, pieces of music, etc. that a performer or group knows and can perform.

words.ex: The colors in the rainbow cover a wide spectrum.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹中的颜色覆盖了广泛的范围。
words.en: A spectrum is a range of a particular type of thing, often a range of colors, ideas, or opinions.

words.tr: n. 倡议；主动权；自发性；措施；
words.ex: The school launched an initiative to reduce plastic use.
words.ex_cn: 学校发起了一项减少塑料使用的倡议。
words.en: An initiative is an important act or statement that is intended to solve a problem.

words.tr:
adj. 急动的；颠簸的；抽筋的
n. 肉干
words.ex: His jerky movements made the camera footage blurry.
words.ex_cn: 他急动的动作让视频画面变得模糊。
words.en: If you describe something as jerky, you mean that it moves in a way that is not smooth, but rather with sudden stops and starts.

words.tr: v. 纺（纱）；旋转；疾驰；“spin”的现在分词； n. 纺织；
words.ex: She is spinning wool into yarn.
words.ex_cn: 她正在把羊毛纺成纱线。
words.en: the process or activity of spinning fibers to produce yarn or thread.

words.ex: The child was wobbling on the bike.
words.ex_cn: 孩子骑自行车时摇摇晃晃。
words.en: To move unsteadily from side to side.

words.ex: The car stopped quickly when he pressed the brakes.
words.ex_cn: 当他踩下刹车时，车很快就停了。
words.en: Brakes are devices in a vehicle that make it go slower or stop.

words.ex: The pond is shallow, so you can see the bottom.
words.ex_cn: 这个池塘很浅，所以你能看到底部。
words.en: If something is shallow, it does not extend far down from the top surface.

words.ex: He cannot comprehend the simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他无法理解这个简单的数学问题。
words.en: To comprehend something means to understand it fully.

words.ex: The poem uses metaphors to describe love.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗用隐喻来描述爱情。
words.en: A metaphor is a figure of speech in which a word or phrase is applied to an object or action to which it is not literally applicable.

words.tr: n. 艺术家；画家；“artist”的复数；
words.ex: The artists painted beautiful pictures.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家们画了美丽的画。
words.en: An artist is someone who draws or paints pictures or creates sculptures as a job or a hobby.

words.ex: He showed appreciation for her hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他对她的辛勤工作表示欣赏。
words.en: Recognition of the quality, value, significance, or magnitude of people and things.

words.tr:
v. （使）获得；
adj. 安全的；稳定的；
words.ex: He worked hard to secure a job.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以获得一份工作。
words.en: If you secure something that you want or need, you obtain it, often after a lot of effort.

words.ex: The teacher gave a satisfactory grade.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个令人满意的分数。
words.en: If something is satisfactory, it is good enough or acceptable.

words.tr: adj. 不可避免的；必定的；
words.ex: It is inevitable that the sun will rise tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳明天一定会升起。
words.en: If something is inevitable, it is certain to happen and cannot be prevented or avoided.

words.tr:
adj. 制药的；配药的；
n. 药物；
words.ex: He works at a pharmaceutical company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家制药公司工作。
words.en: relating to the production and sale of medicinal drugs

words.ex: He walked alongside the river.
words.ex_cn: 他沿着河边走。
words.en: If one thing is alongside another thing, the first thing is next to the second.

words.ex: Therapists help people feel better after伤心.
words.ex_cn: 治疗专家帮助人们在伤心后感觉更好。
words.en: A therapist is a person who is trained to treat people who are ill or who have problems with their mental health.

words.ex: He was reluctant to leave his home.
words.ex_cn: 他不愿意离开家。
words.en: If you are reluctant to do something, you are unwilling to do it and hesitate before doing it, or do it slowly and without enthusiasm.

words.tr: v. 规定；开药方；“prescribe”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 规定的；法定的；
words.ex: The doctor prescribed medicine for the cough.
words.ex_cn: 医生规定了治疗咳嗽的药物。
words.en: If a doctor prescribes medicine or treatment for you, he or she tells you what medicine or treatment to have.

words.ex: The doctor suggested a natural remedy for the cold.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议了一种治疗感冒的天然疗法。
words.en: A remedy is a cure or a way of making something better.

words.ex: She drinks herbal tea every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喝草药茶。
words.en: Relating to or made from herbs, especially those used in medicine and cooking.

words.ex: He read the previous chapter last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚读了前一章。
words.en: Existing or occurring before in time or order.

words.ex: He follows the orthodox religious practices.
words.ex_cn: 他遵循正统的宗教习俗。
words.en: Orthodox beliefs, methods, or systems are ones which are accepted or used by most people.

words.tr: n. 再训练； v. “retrain”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company offered retraining for workers who lost their jobs.
words.ex_cn: 公司为失业的员工提供了再训练。
words.en: The process of learning new skills or being taught new skills, especially in order to be able to do a different job or to improve your performance in your current job.

words.ex: He tried acupuncture to relieve his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他尝试针刺疗法来缓解背痛。
words.en: Acupuncture is a form of treatment that involves inserting very thin needles through a person's skin at specific points on the body, to various depths, for therapeutic purposes.

words.tr: phrase. 医疗投诉；就诊主诉；患者对疾病的陈述
words.ex: He listed his medical complaints to the doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他向医生列出了自己的病情。
words.en: Medical complaints refer to expressions of dissatisfaction by patients or their representatives regarding the medical care or treatment received, which may involve issues related to diagnosis, treatment, or the behavior of healthcare providers.

words.ex: He shared some new insights about the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他分享了关于这个问题的一些新见解。
words.en: The ability to understand and realize what people or situations are really like.

words.tr: n. 危险的根源；危险；危险( hazard的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The factory workers faced many hazards every day.
words.ex_cn: 工厂工人每天面临许多危险的根源。
words.en: A hazard is something which could be dangerous to you, your health or safety, or your plans or reputation.

words.ex: The actors had a rehearsal before the play.
words.ex_cn: 演出前，演员们进行了一次排练。
words.en: A rehearsal of a play, dance, or piece of music is a practice of it in preparation for a performance.

words.ex: He reached adulthood at age 18.
words.ex_cn: 他在18岁时成年。
words.en: The period of time in a person's life when they are fully developed physically and mentally.

words.ex: He took a defensive position to protect the goal.
words.ex_cn: 他采取了防守姿势来保护球门。
words.en: If someone is defensive, they are behaving in a way that shows they are anxious or angry because they feel that they are being criticized.

words.ex: The heart is an important organ in the body.
words.ex_cn: 心脏是身体中重要的器官。
words.en: An organ is a part of an organism that is typically self-contained and has a specific vital function, such as the heart or liver in humans.

words.ex: This is an evolutionary change in the species.
words.ex_cn: 这是该物种的一种进化的改变。
words.en: Relating to or denoting processes of development or growth, especially in a biological context.

words.ex: There is a tendency for people to use phones before bed.
words.ex_cn: 人们在睡觉前使用手机是一种趋势。
words.en: A tendency is a likelihood of behaving in a particular way or going in a particular direction, which is often bad or undesirable.

words.tr: v. 参与；从事；吸引；与…建立密切关系；
words.ex: He engages in community volunteer work.
words.ex_cn: 他参与社区志愿工作。
words.en: To engage means to occupy, attract, or involve someone or oneself in a particular activity or situation.

words.ex: She combines flour and water to make dough.
words.ex_cn: 她把面粉和水混合在一起做面团。
words.en: To combine means to join or merge two or more things together to form a single entity.

words.ex: He learned new techniques to fix the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他学会了新的技术来修理这台机器。
words.en: Techniques are methods or ways of doing something, especially those that require skill.

words.ex: He added many quotations from Shakespeare in his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他在论文中引用了许多莎士比亚的名言。
words.en: A quotation is a sentence or phrase taken from a book, poem, play, etc., which is repeated by someone else. It can also refer to a statement of the current price of a security or commodity.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；例证；例示
words.ex: This example exemplifies the rule clearly.
words.ex_cn: 这个例子清楚地说明了这条规则。
words.en: To exemplify means to be a typical example of something or to give an example of something.

words.tr:
v. 提到；说到；
n. 提及；说起；
words.ex: He didn't mention the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他没有提到那场事故。
words.en: If you mention something, you say something about it, usually briefly.

words.ex: He reject the job offer.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝了这份工作邀请。
words.en: If you reject something such as a proposal, a request, or an offer, you do not accept it or you do not agree to it.

words.ex: He reacts quickly when he hears a loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到大声响时，他会迅速做出反应。
words.en: When you react to something that has happened to you, you behave in a particular way because of it.

words.ex: The bank gave a loan to the student.
words.ex_cn: 银行向学生提供了一笔贷款。
words.en: A loan is a sum of money that you borrow.

words.ex: The barn is used for storage of grain.
words.ex_cn: 这个谷仓用于粮食的贮存。
words.en: The act of storing something or the space where things are stored.

words.ex: He is an ambitious student who wants to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有雄心的学生，想成为一名医生。
words.en: Having or showing a strong desire and determination to succeed.

words.tr: n. 不可预测性；不可预见性；
words.ex: The unpredictability of the weather made planning difficult.
words.ex_cn: 天气的不可预测性使规划变得困难。
words.en: The quality of being unable to be predicted; the state of being unpredictable.

words.ex: The earth's crust is made of rock.
words.ex_cn: 地球的地壳由岩石组成。
words.en: The crust is the hard outer layer of something, such as bread or the Earth's surface.

words.ex: The molten lava flowed down the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 熔化的岩浆从山上流下。
words.en: Molten is used to describe substances that have been heated to a very high temperature and have turned into a liquid.

words.ex: The mantle lies below the Earth's crust.
words.ex_cn: 地幔位于地球地壳之下。
words.en: The mantle is the part of the earth between the crust and the core. It can also refer to a cloak or covering.

words.tr: adj. 不活动的；不活跃的；怠惰的；
words.ex: The old man is inactive because of his illness.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人因为生病而不活动。
words.en: If someone or something is inactive, they are not doing anything or are not working.

words.ex: The mineral outcrops appear on the hillside.
words.ex_cn: 矿脉在山坡上露出。
words.en: An outcrop is a visible exposure of bedrock or ancient superficial deposits on the surface of the Earth.

words.ex: The table is made of granite.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是花岗岩做的。
words.en: Granite is a very hard rock that is often used in building.

words.ex: A bird emerged from the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一只鸟从树中浮现出来。
words.en: If something or someone emerges, they come out of or move out of something and become visible.

words.ex: The lamp emits a soft light.
words.ex_cn: 灯发出柔和的光。
words.en: To emit means to send out something such as light, heat, sound, gas, etc.

words.tr: adj. 不自然的；忸怩的；难为情的
words.ex: He felt self-conscious when speaking in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在全班面前说话时感到不自然。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as self-conscious, you mean that they are strongly aware of who or what they are.

words.ex: The police relied on an informant to find the thief.
words.ex_cn: 警察依靠一名信息提供人找到了小偷。
words.en: An informant is someone who gives information to another person or organization, especially information that is secret or private.

words.ex: He is a non-linguist who cannot understand grammar rules.
words.ex_cn: 他是个不懂语言学的人，无法理解语法规则。
words.en: A non-linguist is someone who is not a specialist in linguistics.

words.ex: The police opened an enquiry into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起事故展开了调查。
words.en: An enquiry is a question you ask in order to get some information.

words.ex: The linguist analyzed the English corpus to find common phrases.
words.ex_cn: 语言学家分析了英语语料库以寻找常用短语。
words.en: A corpus is a large collection of written or spoken texts that is used for language research.

words.ex: The linguist analyzes English corpora to study word usage.
words.ex_cn: 语言学家分析英语语料库以研究词语用法。
words.en: A collection of written or spoken texts used for linguistic analysis.

words.ex: He took an intensive English course last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，他参加了一个密集的英语课程。
words.en: Intensive is used to describe something that involves a lot of effort, energy, or attention in a short period of time.

words.tr:
v. 爆裂；突然而起；
n. 爆裂；突然而起；
words.ex: The balloon burst when he blew too much air.
words.ex_cn: 当他吹入太多空气时，气球爆裂了。
words.en: If something bursts or if you burst it, it suddenly breaks open or splits open and the air or other substance inside it comes out; used especially to describe the sound of something breaking open.

words.ex: The food supply was inadequate for the number of people.
words.ex_cn: 食物供应对人数来说是不充分的。
words.en: If something is inadequate, there is not enough of it or it is not good enough.

words.ex: The sun softened the ice on the road.
words.ex_cn: 太阳使路上的冰变软了。
words.en: To make or become soft or softer.

words.tr:
adj. 正确的；
v. 改正；修正；
words.ex: The answer is correct.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案是正确的。
words.en: If something is correct, it is right and true. If you correct someone, you tell them that they are wrong.

words.tr: adj. 不同的；多种多样的；
words.ex: The class has diverse students from many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级有来自许多国家的不同学生。
words.en: If a group or range of things is diverse, it is made up of a wide variety of things.

words.ex: He is studying anthropology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学里学习人类学。
words.en: Anthropology is the study of human societies and cultures and their development.

words.ex: This is an evolutionary change in the species.
words.ex_cn: 这是该物种的一种进化的改变。
words.en: Relating to or denoting processes of development or growth, especially in a biological context.

words.ex: He can deduce the answer from the clues.
words.ex_cn: 他能从线索中推断出答案。
words.en: If you deduce something or deduce that something is true, you reach that conclusion because of other things that you know to be true.

words.tr: phrase. 医疗机构；医疗体制；医学权威体系
words.ex: The medical establishment supports new health policies.
words.ex_cn: 医疗界支持新的医疗政策。
words.en: A medical establishment refers to a place or organization where medical treatment is provided to patients, such as hospitals, clinics, and health centers.

words.ex: The mirror creates an illusion of a bigger room.
words.ex_cn: 镜子制造出房间更大的错觉。
words.en: An illusion is a false idea or belief, especially about yourself or your situation.

words.ex: We need sustainable energy to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要可持续的能源来保护环境。
words.en: If something is sustainable, it can be maintained or continued at a certain rate or level without causing damage or depletion of resources.

words.ex: His acceptance of the offer made everyone happy.
words.ex_cn: 他接受了这份提议，让大家都很高兴。
words.en: The act of agreeing to receive or undertake something offered.

words.ex: The ship carries a provision of food for the journey.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船为旅程准备了食物供应。
words.en: A provision is a condition or requirement in a legal document. It can also refer to the act of supplying or providing something that is needed.

words.ex: The address is 720 liberty street.
words.ex_cn: 地址是自由大街720号。
words.en: The state of being free within society from oppressive restrictions imposed by authority on one's way of life, behavior, or political views.

words.ex: He consistently arrives at school on time.
words.ex_cn: 他一贯准时到校。
words.en: In a way that does not vary; in the same way over time.

words.ex: He underestimated the difficulty of the test.
words.ex_cn: 他低估了考试的难度。
words.en: If you underestimate something, you do not realize how large, great, or serious it is.

words.ex: He wrote a scholarly article about ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于古代历史的学术性文章。
words.en: A scholarly person or activity is serious and academic, and involves a lot of reading and studying.

words.tr: adj. 现代的；当代的；同时代的；
words.ex: This museum displays contemporary art.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆展示现代艺术。
words.en: Belonging to or occurring in the present; or a person or thing living or existing at the same time as another.

words.tr: n. 细微的差别等；细微( subtlety的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The subtleties of the two dialects are hard to notice.
words.ex_cn: 这两种方言之间的细微差别很难察觉。
words.en: The quality or state of being subtle, especially in terms of being difficult to detect or analyze.

words.ex: His painting shows great originality.
words.ex_cn: 他的画作展现了极大的独创性。
words.en: The quality of being new and original in a way that is not derived from something else.

words.ex: The central park is in the middle of the city.
words.ex_cn: 中央公园位于城市中心。
words.en: Something that is central is of key or fundamental importance.

words.ex: He lives in a small garret above the shop.
words.ex_cn: 他住在商店上面的一个小阁楼里。
words.en: A garret is a room on the top floor of a house, immediately under the roof.

words.ex: He waited for hours, and eventually got his turn.
words.ex_cn: 他等了几个小时，终于轮到他了。
words.en: At an unspecified later time; in the end.

words.ex: The outcome of the game was a tie.
words.ex_cn: 比赛的结果是平局。
words.en: The outcome of an activity, process, or situation is the situation that exists at the end of it.

words.ex: The study explores sociobiological behaviors in ants.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究探讨了蚂蚁的社会生物学行为。
words.en: Relating to the study of the biological (especially ecological and evolutionary) aspects of social behavior.

words.tr: v. 公开指责；告发；揭发
words.ex: He denounces corruption in his speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中谴责腐败。
words.en: If you denounce a person or an action, you criticize them severely and publicly because you feel strongly that they are wrong or evil.

words.ex: Psychiatrists help people with mental problems.
words.ex_cn: 精神科医生帮助有心理问题的人。
words.en: Psychiatrists are medical doctors who specialize in the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of mental illnesses and emotional disorders.

words.tr: n. 指令；说明；指示；“instruction”的复数；
words.ex: Follow the instructions on the box.
words.ex_cn: 按照盒子上的指令操作。
words.en: Instructions are detailed information about how to do something, especially how to use a piece of equipment or perform a task.

words.ex: The constructions along the river are very old.
words.ex_cn: 河边的建筑物非常古老。
words.en: The act or process of building or constructing something; the way in which something is built or put together.

words.tr: v. 给予（药物或治疗）；管理；实施；
words.ex: The nurse will administer the medicine to the patient.
words.ex_cn: 护士会给病人服药。
words.en: To administer means to manage or oversee the execution, use, or conduct of something; to dispense or apply (a remedy or drug).

words.ex: The body has a mechanism to fight viruses.
words.ex_cn: 人体有一种对抗病毒的机制。
words.en: A mechanism is a part of a machine that does a particular task, or a system that is intended to achieve something or deal with a problem.

words.ex: The country's industrialisation began in the 1950s.
words.ex_cn: 该国的工业化始于20世纪50年代。
words.en: Industrialisation is the process by which an economy is transformed from primarily agricultural to one based on the manufacturing of goods. Individual manual labor is often replaced by mechanized mass production, and craftsmen are replaced by assembly lines.

words.ex: He uses scientific methods to test his idea.
words.ex_cn: 他用科学方法来测试他的想法。
words.en: Scientific means relating to science or using the methods of science.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；给书籍、杂志等加插图；
words.ex: The teacher illustrated the point with a simple story.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一个简单的故事来举例说明这个观点。
words.en: To illustrate something means to explain or demonstrate it clearly, often by giving examples or by using pictures or diagrams.

words.ex: The earthquake caused catastrophic damage.
words.ex_cn: 地震造成了灾难性的破坏。
words.en: A catastrophic event or situation is one that causes great damage or suffering.

words.ex: The doctor said the patient needs urgent care.
words.ex_cn: 医生说病人需要紧急治疗。
words.en: If something is urgent, it needs to be dealt with as soon as possible.

words.tr: n. 整形外科；外科修补术；“plastic”的复数；
words.ex: He went to the hospital for plastics after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他去医院做了整形外科手术。
words.en: Plastics are materials which are produced from oil by a chemical process and which are used to make many objects. They are light in weight and do not break easily.

words.tr:
n. 模具；霉；
v. 铸造；
words.ex: The clay was poured into the mould to shape the pot.
words.ex_cn: 将黏土倒入模具中以塑造花盆。
words.en: A mould is a hollow container that you pour a liquid or soft substance into, which then becomes solid in the same shape as the container. Mould can also refer to a fungus that grows on old food or on damp surfaces.

words.ex: The origin of this tradition is unknown.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统的起源不明。
words.en: The origin of something is the point or place where it begins, or the cause from which it arises.

words.tr: adj. （合成树脂）热固的，热变定的；
words.ex: The plastic is thermosetting, so it doesn't melt when heated.
words.ex_cn: 这种塑料是热固性的，因此加热时不会熔化。
words.en: Thermosetting refers to a material that becomes permanently hard when heated and cannot be remolded or softened by further heating.

words.tr: n. 象牙；象牙色 adj. 象牙色的
words.ex: The old piano has ivory keys.
words.ex_cn: 这架旧钢琴有象牙键。
words.en: Ivory is a hard, white material from the tusks and teeth of animals, which is used to make or decorate objects.

words.ex: Phenol is used in some disinfectants.
words.ex_cn: 石碳酸用于一些消毒剂中。
words.en: A toxic white crystalline solid obtained from coal tar and used in chemical manufacture, and in dilute form as a disinfectant.

words.ex: Formaldehyde is used in some glues.
words.ex_cn: 甲醛用于一些胶水中。
words.en: A colorless gas with a pungent smell, used as a preservative and disinfectant.

words.ex: She combines flour and water to make dough.
words.ex_cn: 她把面粉和水混合在一起做面团。
words.en: To combine means to join or merge two or more things together to form a single entity.

words.tr:
n. 真空；空虚；
v. 用真空吸尘器打扫；
words.ex: The vacuum in space keeps no air.
words.ex_cn: 太空中的真空没有空气。
words.en: A vacuum is a space that contains no air or other gas, or a space from which most of the air or gas has been removed. It can also refer to a device that cleans floors and surfaces by sucking up dirt and dust.

words.ex: The tree produces a sticky resin.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树会分泌一种粘稠的树脂。
words.en: A sticky substance secreted by some trees, used in varnishes, adhesives, and plastics.

words.tr: adj. 变硬的； v. “harden”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The hardened clay cracked in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 变硬的黏土在阳光下裂开了。
words.en: If you describe someone as hardened, you mean that they have had so much experience of something bad or unpleasant that they are no longer affected by it in the way that other people would be.

words.ex: He grinds the coffee beans into powder.
words.ex_cn: 他把咖啡豆碾成粉末。
words.en: To reduce something to small particles or powder by crushing it.

words.ex: Old houses sometimes have asbestos in the walls.
words.ex_cn: 老房子的墙壁里有时含有石棉。
words.en: A fibrous mineral form of magnesium silicate, used in fire-resistant and insulating materials.

words.ex: Enzymes act as catalysts in the human body.
words.ex_cn: 酶在人体内充当催化剂。
words.en: A catalyst is a substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction without itself undergoing any permanent chemical change. It can also refer to a person or thing that precipitates an event.

words.ex: Ammonia has a strong smell.
words.ex_cn: 氨有一种刺鼻的气味。
words.en: Ammonia is a colorless gas with a characteristic pungent smell. It is used in the manufacture of fertilizers and as a refrigerant.

words.ex: He felt intense pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到剧烈的疼痛。
words.en: If you describe an activity as intense, you mean that it is very serious and concentrated, and often involves doing a great deal in a short time.

words.ex: The limitations of the machine make it slow.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的局限性让它很慢。
words.en: Limitations refer to the act of limiting or the state of being limited; a restriction.

words.ex: The preparation for the exam took two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 考试的准备花了两周时间。
words.en: Preparation is the process of getting something ready for use or for a particular purpose.

words.tr: adj. 多方面的；有多种技能的；
words.ex: He is a versatile player who can play many positions.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名多方面的运动员，能打多个位置。
words.en: Able to adapt or be adapted to many different functions or activities.

words.tr: adj. 紧张不安的；神经系统的；
words.ex: He felt nervous before the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到紧张不安。
words.en: If someone is nervous, they are frightened or worried about something that is happening or might happen, and show this in their behavior.

words.ex: Chimpanzees live in forests in Africa.
words.ex_cn: 黑猩猩生活在非洲的森林里。
words.en: Chimpanzees are great apes native to the forest and savannah of tropical Africa. They are highly intelligent and social animals, known for their use of tools and complex communication systems.

words.ex: His outlook on life is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活的观点非常积极。
words.en: Your outlook is your general attitude towards life.

words.ex: The prefrontal cortex helps us make good decisions.
words.ex_cn: 前额叶皮层帮助我们做出好的决定。
words.en: The prefrontal cortex is the anterior part of the frontal lobes of the brain, involved in decision making, social behavior, and personality expression.

words.ex: He answered the question instantly.
words.ex_cn: 他立即回答了问题。
words.en: If something happens instantly, it happens immediately.

words.ex: Going first is a privilege, not a right.
words.ex_cn: 优先权是一种特权，而不是权利。
words.en: A privilege is a special right or advantage that only one person or group has.

words.tr: n. 数学家( mathematician的名词复数 )
words.ex: Mathematicians solve difficult problems with numbers.
words.ex_cn: 数学家用数字解决难题。
words.en: A mathematician is a person who is trained in the study of numbers and calculations.

words.ex: Parents should foster good habits in children.
words.ex_cn: 父母应该培养孩子的好习惯。
words.en: To foster something means to encourage and promote its development.

words.ex: He will overtake the car ahead soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就会超过前面的车。
words.en: If you overtake someone, you go past them because you are moving faster than they are.

words.tr:
v. 推翻；颠覆；打倒
n. 推翻；颠覆；打倒
words.ex: The court will overturn the old law.
words.ex_cn: 法院将推翻这项旧法律。
words.en: If a decision, result, etc. is overturned, it is officially changed so that it becomes the opposite of what it was before.

words.ex: He worked overtime to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他加班完成了这个项目。
words.en: Overtime refers to the time worked beyond one's regular working hours, often with additional pay.

words.ex: The people tried to overthrow the corrupt government.
words.ex_cn: 人民试图推翻腐败的政府。
words.en: To overthrow a government or a leader means to remove them from power, often by force.

words.ex: The truck suffered an overload and broke down.
words.ex_cn: 这辆卡车因超载而抛锚了。
words.en: To load or burden someone or something excessively.

words.tr:
adj. 总的；全面的；总体的；
adv. 总计；大致上；
words.ex: The overall cost is too high.
words.ex_cn: 总成本太高了。
words.en: You use overall to indicate that you are talking about a situation in general or about the whole of something.

words.ex: He overcame his fear of speaking in public.
words.ex_cn: 他克服了当众演讲的恐惧。
words.en: If you overcome a problem or a feeling, you successfully deal with it and control it.

words.tr:
adj. 在头顶上的；
adv. 在空中；
words.ex: The overhead light is too bright.
words.ex_cn: 头顶上的灯太亮了。
words.en: You use overhead to indicate that something is above you or above the place that you are talking about.

words.tr:
adj. 来自海外的；往海外的
adv. 向海外；在海外
words.ex: He bought an overseas toy for his son.
words.ex_cn: 他为儿子买了一件来自海外的玩具。
words.en: Located, originating from, or happening in a country across the sea.

words.ex: The report gives an overview of the project.
words.ex_cn: 这份报告对项目进行了概述。
words.en: An overview is a general summary or review of a subject.

words.tr:
adj. 拉丁语的；拉丁语系国家的；
n. 拉丁语；
words.ex: He read a latin text in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上读了一篇拉丁语文本。
words.en: Latin is the language of ancient Rome and its empire, widely used historically as a language of scholarship and administration.

words.ex: There is strong competition between the two companies.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司之间竞争激烈。
words.en: Competition is a situation in which two or more people or groups are trying to get something which not everyone can have.

words.ex: The magnet shows strong magnetism.
words.ex_cn: 这个磁铁显示出很强的磁性。
words.en: Magnetism is a physical phenomenon produced by the motion of electric charge, resulting in attractive and repulsive forces between objects.

words.ex: He is learning elementary math at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习初级数学。
words.en: Elementary means relating to the simplest and most basic aspects of a subject.

words.ex: The city has many old canals.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市有许多古老的运河。
words.en: A canal is a long, narrow stretch of water that has been made for boats to travel along or to bring water to a particular area.

words.tr: n. 潟湖；污水池( lagoon的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The fish swim in the quiet lagoons.
words.ex_cn: 鱼儿在宁静的潟湖中游动。
words.en: A lagoon is a shallow body of water separated from a larger body of water by barrier islands or reefs.

words.ex: The plant uses desalination to make seawater drinkable.
words.ex_cn: 该工厂使用脱盐作用将海水变为可饮用水。
words.en: The process of removing salt from seawater to make it suitable for drinking or irrigation.

words.ex: Rivers carry sediment to the sea.
words.ex_cn: 河流把沉积物带到大海。
words.en: Material that settles to the bottom of a liquid; matter that has been deposited by some natural process.

words.tr: phrase. 人工洪水；人为制造的洪水
words.ex: The government created artificial floods to replenish the wetlands.
words.ex_cn: 政府制造了人工洪水以补充湿地。
words.en: Artificial floods are man-made events where water is deliberately released to simulate natural flooding for environmental or agricultural purposes.

words.tr: phrase. 天然洪水；自然发生的洪涝灾害
words.ex: The area is prone to natural floods during the rainy season.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区在雨季容易发生自然洪水。
words.en: Natural floods refer to the overflow of water onto land that is normally dry, caused by natural processes such as heavy rainfall, rapid snowmelt, or the breaking of natural dams.

words.tr: adv. 用电子方法；用电子装置；运用电子仪器进行；
words.ex: She paid for the book electronically.
words.ex_cn: 她用电子方式支付了这本书的费用。
words.en: In a way that involves the use of electronic devices or technology.

words.ex: The baby's neural connections are developing fast.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿的神经连接正在迅速发展。
words.en: Neural relates to a nerve or the nervous system.

words.tr: adj. 现代的；当代的；同时代的；
words.ex: This museum displays contemporary art.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆展示现代艺术。
words.en: Belonging to or occurring in the present; or a person or thing living or existing at the same time as another.

words.tr: v. 证明...正当；“justify”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有正当理由的；
words.ex: He justified his actions by telling the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他通过讲真话来证明自己的行为是正当的。
words.en: If you describe a decision, action, or idea as justified, you think it is reasonable and acceptable because it is based on facts or good reasons.

words.tr: n. 取得成果；实现；完成
words.ex: The project finally came to fruition after years of hard work.
words.ex_cn: 经过多年的努力，这个项目终于完成了。
words.en: The realization or fulfillment of a plan or project.

words.ex: The implementation of the new rule took one month.
words.ex_cn: 新规则的履行花了一个月。
words.en: The act of putting a decision or plan into effect; execution.

words.ex: The prospect of a better job makes him happy.
words.ex_cn: 更好工作的前景让他感到高兴。
words.en: A prospect is the possibility that something will happen, or a view of a wide area.

words.ex: The children are learning about food-gathering in ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在学习古代的觅食方式。
words.en: The activity of collecting food from wild sources, a method used by early humans before the advent of agriculture.

words.tr: n. 印刷品；讲义；施舍物；救济品；“handout”的复数；
words.ex: The teacher gave out handouts for the lesson.
words.ex_cn: 老师发了这节课的印刷品。
words.en: Handouts are papers containing information or tasks that are given to people, especially students, to help them learn or understand something.

words.ex: The company got a lot of publicity from the TV ad.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司从电视广告中获得了大量宣传。
words.en: Publicity is the activity of making sure that someone or something attracts a lot of interest or attention from the public, especially by providing information about them in newspapers, on television, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 硫化镍（一种由镍和硫组成的化合物，常见于矿物或工业材料中）
words.ex: Nickel sulphide is commonly used in the production of batteries.
words.ex_cn: 硫化镍常用于电池的生产。
words.en: Nickel sulphide is a chemical compound consisting of nickel and sulfur, often used in various industrial applications.

words.ex: He tried to suppress his anger.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抑制自己的愤怒。
words.en: To suppress something means to prevent it from being expressed, known, or continuing.

words.tr: v. 变坚韧；变顽强；变强硬；变困难
words.ex: The leather will toughen as it dries.
words.ex_cn: 皮革干燥后会变得坚韧。
words.en: To toughen someone or something means to make them stronger or more able to deal with difficult conditions or situations.

words.ex: I recommend this book to you.
words.ex_cn: 我向你推荐这本书。
words.en: If someone recommends a person or thing to you, they suggest that you would find them good or useful.

words.ex: The glass broke into small fragments.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃碎成了小碎片。
words.en: A fragment of something is a small piece or part of it.

words.tr: v. 使粉碎；使破碎；使破灭；
words.ex: The stone shattered when it hit the ground.
words.ex_cn: 石头撞到地面时碎裂了。
words.en: If something shatters or is shattered, it breaks into a lot of small pieces.

words.tr: phrase. 内层；内部涂层；内侧膜
words.ex: The inner layer of the jacket is made of soft fleece to keep you warm.
words.ex_cn: n. 夹克的内层由柔软的羊毛制成，以保持温暖。
words.en: The term 'inner layer' refers to a layer that is inside or beneath another layer, often providing support, protection, or additional functionality.

words.tr: n. 杂质；不纯( impurity的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The water has many impurities.
words.ex_cn: 这种水有很多杂质。
words.en: Impurities are substances that are present in small quantities in another substance and make it dirty or of an unacceptable quality.

words.ex: The sun shines on the crystals and makes them sparkle.
words.ex_cn: 阳光照在晶体上，使它们闪闪发光。
words.en: Crystals are solid materials whose constituents (such as atoms, molecules, or ions) are arranged in a highly ordered microscopic structure, forming a crystal lattice that extends in all directions.

words.ex: The window has a broken pane.
words.ex_cn: 这扇窗户有一块碎了的玻璃。
words.en: A pane is a piece of glass that is fitted into a window or door.

words.ex: He likes reading, and furthermore, he writes stories too.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读，而且他还写故事。
words.en: In addition to what has been said; moreover.

words.tr: adj. 精密复杂的；老练的；
words.ex: The phone has a sophisticated camera.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机有一个精密复杂的摄像头。
words.en: A sophisticated person is intelligent and knows a lot, so that they are able to understand complicated situations. A sophisticated machine, device, or method is more advanced or complex than others.

words.ex: There are numerous books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有许多书。
words.en: If people or things are numerous, they exist or are present in large numbers.

words.tr:
n. 纠纷；争端；
v. 对（某事）有异议；
words.ex: The dispute between the two neighbors was about the fence.
words.ex_cn: 两个邻居之间的纠纷是关于篱笆的。
words.en: A dispute is a disagreement or argument about something important.

words.ex: Plants exhibit photoperiodism by flowering in response to changes in day length.
words.ex_cn: 植物通过开花来响应日照长度的变化，表现出光周期现象。
words.en: Photoperiodism is the physiological reaction of organisms to the length of day or night, influencing processes such as flowering in plants and breeding in animals.

words.tr:
v. 交配繁殖；饲养；
n. 品种；
words.ex: The farmers breed cows to get more milk.
words.ex_cn: 农民让奶牛交配繁殖以获得更多牛奶。
words.en: If you breed animals or plants, you keep them for the purpose of producing more animals or plants with particular qualities, in a controlled way.

words.ex: The deer avoided the hemlock because it is poisonous.
words.ex_cn: 鹿避开了毒芹，因为它是有毒的。
words.en: Hemlock is a highly poisonous plant, especially the poison hemlock, Conium maculatum, of the parsley family. It is also the name of the poison derived from this plant.

words.ex: The rhythm of the music made everyone dance.
words.ex_cn: 音乐的节奏让所有人都跳起了舞。
words.en: A rhythm is a regular series of sounds or movements.

words.ex: The weather is unpredictable today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气不可预测。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as unpredictable, you mean that you cannot tell what they are going to do or how they are going to behave.

words.ex: The garden is full of colorful annuals in summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天，花园里开满了五颜六色的一年生植物。
words.en: Annuals are plants that complete their life cycle within one year and then die. They are often used in gardening for their vibrant colors and quick growth.

words.ex: His tolerance for different opinions is impressive.
words.ex_cn: 他对不同观点的宽容令人印象深刻。
words.en: The ability or willingness to tolerate the existence of opinions or behaviour that one dislikes or disagrees with.

words.ex: The main criterion for winning is fairness.
words.ex_cn: 获胜的主要标准是公平。
words.en: A criterion is a principle or standard by which something may be judged or decided.

words.ex: He works in horticulture at a local garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在当地的一个花园从事园艺工作。
words.en: Horticulture is the study and practice of growing and cultivating plants, especially flowers, fruits, and vegetables.

words.tr:
n. 信号；
v. 用信号通知；
words.ex: The traffic light is a signal to stop.
words.ex_cn: 交通灯是一个停止的信号。
words.en: A signal is a gesture, sound, or action which is intended to give a particular message to the person who sees or hears it.

words.ex: The big rock was an obstacle on the road.
words.ex_cn: 那块大石头是路上的障碍。
words.en: An obstacle is something which makes it difficult for you to go forward or to achieve something.

words.ex: This temperature is the optimum for growing plants.
words.ex_cn: 这个温度是最适宜植物生长的。
words.en: The optimum is the best or most favorable condition, degree, amount, etc., for achieving a particular result.

words.ex: The report gives an overview of the project.
words.ex_cn: 这份报告对项目进行了概述。
words.en: An overview is a general summary or review of a subject.

words.tr:
n. 竞争者；敌手；
v. 竞争；相匹敌；
words.ex: He is my main rival in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他是我在比赛中主要的竞争者。
words.en: A rival is a person, group, or organization that you are competing with in the same activity or the same area.

words.ex: The robot uses a sensor to detect walls.
words.ex_cn: 机器人使用传感器来检测墙壁。
words.en: A sensor is a device which reacts to certain physical conditions or impressions such as heat or light, and which is used to provide information.

words.tr: phrase. 高原帐篷；高海拔训练帐篷（用于模拟高海拔低氧环境以提高运动员耐力）
words.ex: Athletes use altitude tents to simulate high-altitude conditions and improve their endurance.
words.ex_cn: 运动员使用高原帐篷来模拟高海拔条件，以提高他们的耐力。
words.en: A type of tent designed to simulate high-altitude conditions, used by athletes to improve endurance by increasing red blood cell production.

words.tr: n. 骑自行车的人；自行车选手；“cyclist”的复数；
words.ex: The cyclists rode through the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车的人每天早上都穿过公园。
words.en: Cyclists are people who ride bicycles, especially those who do it regularly or as a sport.

words.ex: Efficient cargo-handling is crucial for the timely delivery of goods.
words.ex_cn: 高效的货物装卸对于货物的及时交付至关重要。
words.en: The process of loading, unloading, and moving goods in a port, airport, or warehouse.

words.ex: The freight train carried boxes to the city.
words.ex_cn: 货运列车把箱子运到了城市。
words.en: Freight refers to goods transported in bulk by truck, train, ship, or aircraft. It can also mean the charge for such transportation.

words.ex: The car has a streamlined shape to reduce wind resistance.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车具有流线型的外形以减少风阻。
words.en: Designed or arranged to offer the least resistance to fluid flow; made efficient by simplifying or eliminating unnecessary elements.

words.tr: n. 关税；税率；（旅馆、饭店等的）价目表
words.ex: The government raised the tariff on imported cars.
words.ex_cn: 政府提高了进口汽车的关税。
words.en: A tariff is a tax that a government collects on goods coming into a country.

words.ex: The factory's output increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂上个月的产量增加了。
words.en: The amount of something produced by a person, machine, or industry.

words.ex: The Inuit live in cold northern regions.
words.ex_cn: 因纽特人生活在寒冷的北方地区。
words.en: The Inuit are a group of culturally similar indigenous peoples inhabiting the Arctic regions of Greenland, Canada, and Alaska.

words.ex: The storm caused unprecedented damage.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴造成了前所未有的破坏。
words.en: If something is unprecedented, it has never happened before.

words.ex: The country expanded its territory after the war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在战争后扩大了它的领土。
words.en: An area of land that is controlled by a particular country, ruler, or military force.

words.ex: The team consists of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something consists of particular things or people, it is made up of them.

words.ex: The inhabitant lives in a small house.
words.ex_cn: 这位居民住在一所小房子里。
words.en: An inhabitant of a place is one of the people who live there.

words.tr: n. 食物；营养；维持生计
words.ex: Water and food are basic sustenance for life.
words.ex_cn: 水和食物是生命的基本生存物资。
words.en: Sustenance refers to the food and drink that people, animals, and plants need to live and stay healthy. It can also mean the means of maintaining life or supporting existence.

words.tr:
n. 锻炼；行使；练习；
v. 运用；使用；锻炼；
words.ex: He does exercise every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上锻炼以保持健康。
words.en: Physical activity that you do to make your body strong and healthy.

words.ex: The distribution of students in the class is even.
words.ex_cn: 班级里学生的分布是均匀的。
words.en: The process of giving out or spreading something, or the way in which something is spread or arranged over an area or among a group of people.

words.ex: His contribution helped the team win.
words.ex_cn: 他的贡献帮助团队赢得了比赛。
words.en: A contribution is a gift or payment to a common fund or collection, or the part played by a person or thing in bringing about a result or helping something to advance.

words.ex: The train's destination is Beijing.
words.ex_cn: 这列火车的目的地是北京。
words.en: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.ex: Can you imagine a world without phones?
words.ex_cn: 你能想象一个没有电话的世界吗？
words.en: To imagine means to form a mental image or concept of something that is not present or real.

words.ex: Children have a strong imagination.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们有很强的想象力。
words.en: The ability to form pictures or ideas in your mind of things that are new and exciting, or not real.

words.ex: The inner-city area has seen a rise in crime rates.
words.ex_cn: 市中心区的犯罪率有所上升。
words.en: Relating to or situated in the central part of a city, especially when characterized by poverty, social problems, etc.

words.ex: He performs averagely in math tests.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中表现一般。
words.en: In a manner that is typical or usual; to an average degree.

words.ex: The village is in a hilly area near the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄位于靠近山地的多小山地区。
words.en: A hilly area has a lot of hills.

words.ex: Wearing shorts to the meeting is inappropriate.
words.ex_cn: 穿短裤去参加会议是不合适的。
words.en: If you say that something is inappropriate, you are criticizing it because you think it is not suitable for a particular situation or purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 预期寿命；平均寿命
words.ex: Life expectancy has increased in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多国家的预期寿命已经增加。
words.en: The average period that a person may expect to live.

words.tr: adj. 营养不良的；缺乏营养的
words.ex: The child is undernourished because he eats little food.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子营养不良，因为他吃得很少。
words.en: If someone is undernourished, they are weak and in bad health because they have not been eating enough food or the right kind of food.

words.tr: adj. 恒定的；不变的；持续的；
words.ex: The temperature is constant in this room.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的温度是恒定的。
words.en: Something that is constant happens all the time or is always there.

words.ex: Hormones control growth and mood in the body.
words.ex_cn: 荷尔蒙控制身体的生长和情绪。
words.en: A hormone is a chemical substance produced in the body that controls and regulates the activity of certain cells or organs.

words.tr: phrase. 公民角色；公民责任；社会职责
words.ex: Volunteering is a great way to fulfill your civic role.
words.ex_cn: 志愿服务是履行你公民角色的好方法。
words.en: The responsibilities and activities expected of a citizen in relation to the society or community they live in.

words.ex: He does arithmetic every day with his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他每天和妹妹一起做算术。
words.en: Arithmetic is the part of mathematics that deals with the addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of numbers.

words.ex: The rain persisted all day.
words.ex_cn: 雨持续了一整天。
words.en: If you persist in doing something, you continue to do it even though it is difficult or other people are against it.

words.ex: The tribes live in the forest far from cities.
words.ex_cn: 这些部落生活在远离城市的森林里。
words.en: A tribe is a social group consisting of people of the same race or nationality who share the same customs, traditions, and language.

words.tr: n. 独木舟；独木舟（canoe 的复数）；
words.ex: They paddled canoes down the river.
words.ex_cn: 他们划着独木舟顺流而下。
words.en: A canoe is a narrow, lightweight boat pointed at both ends and open on top, propelled by one or more seated or kneeling paddlers facing the direction of travel and using a single-bladed paddle.

words.ex: The children played with pebbles by the river.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在河边玩小石子。
words.en: Pebbles are small, smooth stones found especially on beaches or in rivers.

words.ex: The movie has many exciting storylines.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影有许多激动人心的故事情节。
words.en: The plot or sequence of events in a narrative, such as a novel, play, or film.

words.ex: The simplicity of the design makes it easy to use.
words.ex_cn: 这种设计的简单使它容易使用。
words.en: The quality or condition of being easy to understand or do.

words.ex: The child gave an imaginative story about flying cats.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子讲了一个关于会飞的猫的富有想象力的故事。
words.en: If you describe someone or their ideas as imaginative, you are praising them because they are easily able to think of or create new or exciting things.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；给书籍、杂志等加插图；
words.ex: The teacher illustrated the point with a simple story.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一个简单的故事来举例说明这个观点。
words.en: To illustrate something means to explain or demonstrate it clearly, often by giving examples or by using pictures or diagrams.

words.ex: The children ran around the fairgrounds on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们周日在露天市场跑来跑去。
words.en: An area of land where fairs, circuses, or exhibitions are held.

words.tr: adj. 不赏识的，不欣赏的
words.ex: She was unappreciative of all the hard work he had put in.
words.ex_cn: 她对他所付出的所有努力都不赏识。
words.en: If you are unappreciative, you do not recognize or value the worth or quality of something or someone.

words.ex: The empire's domination over the region lasted for centuries.
words.ex_cn: 这个帝国对该地区的统治持续了几个世纪。
words.en: The exercise of control or influence over someone or something, or the state of being so controlled.

words.ex: They established a new school in the village.
words.ex_cn: 他们在村里建立了一所新学校。
words.en: To set up or create something, such as an organization or a system, on a firm or permanent basis.

words.ex: The sweater shrinks in hot water.
words.ex_cn: 这件毛衣在热水中会收缩。
words.en: If something shrinks or you shrink it, it becomes smaller.

words.ex: He tried to manipulate the results to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 他试图操纵结果来赢得比赛。
words.en: To manipulate something means to handle or control it skillfully, often in a way that is considered unfair or dishonest.

words.ex: The boss gave a positive appraisal of his work.
words.ex_cn: 老板对他的工作给予了积极的评估。
words.en: An appraisal is a judgement or assessment of the value, nature, or quality of something or someone.

words.ex: He works in a clerical job at the office.
words.ex_cn: 他在办公室做文书工作。
words.en: Clerical means relating to work that is done in an office, especially work that involves keeping records or accounts. It can also refer to the clergy or the religious leaders of a church.

words.ex: The external wall of the house is painted blue.
words.ex_cn: 房子的外墙被刷成了蓝色。
words.en: External is used to indicate that something is on the outside of a surface or body, or that it exists, happens, or comes from outside.

words.ex: He tried to resist the temptation to eat sweets.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抵制吃甜食的诱惑。
words.en: If you resist something such as a change, you refuse to accept it and try to prevent it.

words.ex: She is an attractive woman.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有吸引力的女性。
words.en: An attractive person or thing is pleasing or appealing to look at.

words.tr: adj. 糖尿病的；适合糖尿病患者的
words.ex: He is a diabetic and eats healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名糖尿病患者，吃健康的食物。
words.en: A diabetic is a person who has diabetes.

words.ex: He takes insulin to control his blood sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他注射胰岛素来控制血糖。
words.en: A hormone produced in the pancreas by the islets of Langerhans, which regulates the amount of glucose in the blood. The lack of insulin causes a form of diabetes.

words.ex: The children gave a mimetic performance of the animals.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们表演了模仿动物的节目。
words.en: Mimetic refers to the ability or tendency to mimic or imitate.

words.ex: The lamp emits a soft light.
words.ex_cn: 灯发出柔和的光。
words.en: To emit means to send out something such as light, heat, sound, gas, etc.

words.ex: The new policy is for the promotion of clean energy.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策是为了促进清洁能源。
words.en: A promotion is a move to a more important job or rank in a company or organization.

words.ex: The bonus is an incentive to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 奖金是努力工作的动机。
words.en: Something that encourages a person to do something or to work harder.

words.tr:
n. 代表；典型事物；
adj. 典型的；有代表性的；代议制的；
words.ex: He is the representative of our class.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们班的代表。
words.en: A representative is a person who has been chosen to act or make decisions on behalf of another person or a group of people.

words.ex: The stars are visible at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚可以看到星星。
words.en: If something is visible, it can be seen.

words.ex: The doctor wrote new prescriptions for her medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生为她开了新的处方。
words.en: A prescription is a written order, especially by a physician, for the preparation and administration of a medicine or other treatment.

words.tr: adj. 合法的；法律认可的；合理的；
words.ex: This contract is legitimate and signed by both parties.
words.ex_cn: 这份合同是合法的，并由双方签署。
words.en: Something that is legitimate is acceptable according to the law.

words.tr: phrase. 国民识字率；国家文化水平；全民读写能力
words.ex: The government has launched a new program to improve national literacy.
words.ex_cn: 政府已经启动了一个新项目来提高国民识字率。
words.en: National literacy refers to the percentage of people in a country who can read and write.

words.ex: He joined a crusade for clean water.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一场为清洁用水而发起的运动。
words.en: A crusade is a long and determined attempt to achieve something that you strongly believe in, especially to bring about social or political change.

words.tr:
adj. 文盲的；无知的；
n. 文盲；无知识的人；
words.ex: He is illiterate and cannot read simple signs.
words.ex_cn: 他是文盲，无法阅读简单的标识。
words.en: Someone who is illiterate cannot read or write.

words.ex: We must eliminate the waste to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须消除浪费以保护环境。
words.en: To eliminate something, especially something you do not want or need, means to remove it completely.

words.ex: The mortality rate in the region increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年该地区的死亡率上升了。
words.en: Mortality refers to the state of being subject to death or the number of deaths in a particular population or period.

words.tr: adj. 母亲的；母性的；母系的；
words.ex: Her maternal love kept the family strong.
words.ex_cn: 她的母爱让家庭保持坚强。
words.en: Maternal feelings or actions are typical of a kind, loving mother.

words.tr: phrase. 父亲的读写能力；父亲的文化素养
words.ex: His paternal literacy skills helped him to write letters to his children.
words.ex_cn: 他的父亲识字能力帮助他给孩子们写信。
words.en: Paternal literacy refers to the reading and writing skills of a father, and its influence on his family and children's education.

words.tr:
n. 婴儿；
adj. 初期的；
words.ex: The infant is sleeping in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在婴儿床里睡觉。
words.en: An infant is a baby or very young child.

words.ex: The children were malnourished because they had little food.
words.ex_cn: 这些孩子因为食物很少而营养不良。
words.en: If someone is malnourished, they are physically weak and in poor health because they have not been eating enough food or the right kind of food.

words.tr:
adj. 成熟的；
v. 成熟；
words.ex: He is a mature student who works full-time.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位成熟的学生，全职工作。
words.en: When something or someone matures, they become fully grown or developed. In finance, a mature investment is one that has reached the end of its term and is ready to be paid out.

words.ex: The police opened an enquiry into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起事故展开了调查。
words.en: An enquiry is a question you ask in order to get some information.

words.ex: He is bullying his little brother.
words.ex_cn: 他正在欺负他的弟弟。
words.en: The use of strength or influence to harm or intimidate those who are weaker.

words.ex: He worked here previously.
words.ex_cn: 他以前在这里工作。
words.en: At an earlier time or before.

words.ex: He made a persistent effort to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他持续努力学习英语。
words.en: Continuing firmly or obstinately in a course of action in spite of difficulty or opposition.

words.ex: He felt so sad that he thought about suicide.
words.ex_cn: 他感到非常难过，以至于想到了自杀。
words.en: Suicide is the act of deliberately killing oneself.

words.ex: The country made a declaration of independence.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家发表了独立宣言。
words.en: A declaration is a formal statement or announcement.

words.ex: The school has implemented an anti-bullying policy to protect its students.
words.ex_cn: 学校实施了反欺凌政策以保护学生。
words.en: Opposed to or intended to prevent bullying.

words.ex: He made a permanent change to his lifestyle.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的生活方式做出了永久的改变。
words.en: Something that is permanent exists or happens all the time, or exists for a long time without changing.

words.ex: The teacher gave supervision to the students during the exam.
words.ex_cn: 老师在考试期间监督学生。
words.en: The act of overseeing or directing a project, activity, or person.

words.ex: It was a mere mistake, not intentional.
words.ex_cn: 那只是一个小小的错误，并非故意的。
words.en: You use mere to emphasize how unimportant or inadequate something is, in comparison to the general situation you are describing.

words.tr:
n. 责任；责备；
v. 责怪；归咎于；
words.ex: He took the blame for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了这个错误的责任。
words.en: If you blame a person or thing for something bad, you believe or say that they are responsible for it or that they caused it.

words.ex: Bats use echolocation to find insects in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 蝙蝠利用回声定位在黑暗中寻找昆虫。
words.en: Echolocation is a method used by certain animals to determine the location of objects by emitting sound waves and listening for the echo.

words.ex: The cold water gave her a sudden sensation.
words.ex_cn: 冷水给了她一种突然的感觉。
words.en: A sensation is a physical feeling or a reaction of interest or excitement that something causes in a person or in a group of people.

words.ex: He felt great pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到极大的痛苦。
words.en: Pain is the feeling of great discomfort you have, for example when you have been hurt or when you are ill.

words.ex: I perceive a change in his mood.
words.ex_cn: 我察觉到他的情绪有变化。
words.en: If you perceive something, you see, notice, or realize it, especially when it is not obvious.

words.ex: The fish swim above the seabed.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在海床上方游动。
words.en: The seabed is the bottom of the ocean, consisting of various sediments and rocks.

words.ex: He worked in a factory during wartime.
words.ex_cn: 他在战争期间在工厂工作。
words.en: Wartime refers to the period during which a war is taking place.

words.tr: adj. 精密复杂的；老练的；
words.ex: The phone has a sophisticated camera.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机有一个精密复杂的摄像头。
words.en: A sophisticated person is intelligent and knows a lot, so that they are able to understand complicated situations. A sophisticated machine, device, or method is more advanced or complex than others.

words.ex: The relevance of this topic is clear.
words.ex_cn: 这个主题的相关性是明显的。
words.en: The quality or state of being closely connected or appropriate.

words.ex: She is studying educating psyche to understand how children learn.
words.ex_cn: 她正在学习教育心理学，以了解儿童如何学习。
words.en: The study of the mind and its processes in an educational context.

words.ex: He showed strong emotion when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，表现出了强烈的情绪。
words.en: An emotion is a feeling such as happiness, love, fear, anger, or hatred, which can be caused by the situation that you are in or the people you are with.

words.ex: The motion of the ball is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 球的运动非常快。
words.en: The action or process of moving or being moved.

words.tr: adj. 无意识的；无知觉的；
words.ex: He was unconscious after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他失去了意识。
words.en: If someone is unconscious, they are not awake, usually because they have had a severe injury or illness.

words.tr:
v. 回忆起；召回；
n. 记忆力；
words.ex: I recall my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我想起了我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you recall something, you remember it and tell others about it.

words.ex: The keyboard is a peripheral device.
words.ex_cn: 键盘是一个外围设备。
words.en: A peripheral activity or issue is one that is not very important compared with other activities or issues.

words.ex: This coupon is valid until next month.
words.ex_cn: 这张优惠券到下个月都有效。
words.en: If something such as a document or agreement is valid, it is legally acceptable or officially recognized.

words.ex: He entered a deep hypnosis during the therapy.
words.ex_cn: 他在治疗过程中进入了深度催眠状态。
words.en: Hypnosis is a state in which a person seems to be asleep but can still see, hear, or respond to things said to them.

words.ex: The truck was fined for overloading.
words.ex_cn: 这辆卡车因超载被罚款。
words.en: The act of loading something excessively, beyond its capacity or limit.

words.ex: He has the capacity to solve hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: The capacity of a place or container is the amount of things or people that it can hold.

words.ex: The suggestopedic method accelerates learning by leveraging the power of suggestion.
words.ex_cn: 暗示教学法通过利用暗示的力量加速学习。
words.en: Suggestopedic refers to a teaching method that uses suggestion to enhance learning, often involving relaxation techniques and music to improve memory and learning efficiency.

words.ex: Prior to the meeting, we reviewed the report.
words.ex_cn: 在会议之前，我们复习了报告。
words.en: Existing or coming before in time, order, or importance.

words.ex: He wears conventional clothes to work.
words.ex_cn: 他穿传统服装去上班。
words.en: Conventional ideas, methods, or systems are the ones that are generally accepted and used, and that have been used for a long time.

words.ex: He retains his old photos in a box.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧照片保存在一个盒子里。
words.en: If you retain something, you keep it or continue to have it.

words.ex: He tried to convince her to stay.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服她留下。
words.en: If someone or something convinces you of something, they make you believe that it is true or that it exists.

words.ex: Follow the procedure step by step.
words.ex_cn: 一步一步地按照步骤进行。
words.en: A procedure is a way of doing something, especially the usual or correct way.

words.ex: He likes reading, and furthermore, he writes stories too.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读，而且他还写故事。
words.en: In addition to what has been said; moreover.

words.ex: The sunset was spectacular.
words.ex_cn: 日落非常壮观。
words.en: Something that is spectacular is very impressive or dramatic.

words.ex: The authoritarian leader controls everything.
words.ex_cn: 这位专制的领导人控制一切。
words.en: An authoritarian government or leader has complete power and control over the people and does not allow political opposition.

words.tr: adj. 不引人注意的；普通的
words.ex: The performance was unspectacular but solid.
words.ex_cn: 这场表演虽然不引人注意，但很扎实。
words.en: If you describe something as unspectacular, you mean that it is rather dull and not remarkable in any way.

words.ex: The doctor gave him a placebo to see if his pain would go away.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了他一个安慰剂，看看他的疼痛是否会消失。
words.en: A substance that has no therapeutic effect, used as a control in testing new drugs, or given for its psychological effect to a patient who believes it to be a medicine.

words.tr: n. （宗教等的）仪式；例行习惯；
words.ex: The village holds a ritual every spring to pray for good weather.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄每年春天都举行一个仪式，祈求好天气。
words.en: A ritual is a religious service or other ceremony which involves a series of actions performed in a fixed order.

words.ex: The tourists visited the ancient pagodas on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 游客们参观了山上的古宝塔。
words.en: A pagoda is a tiered tower with multiple eaves, common in East and Southeast Asia, often associated with Buddhist temples.

words.tr: adj. 严重的；严厉的；非常困难的；
words.ex: The storm caused severe damage to the houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对房屋造成了严重的破坏。
words.en: If something is severe, it is very bad or very serious.

words.tr:
n. 内部；
adj. 内部的；
words.ex: The interior of the house is very cozy.
words.ex_cn: 房子的内部非常舒适。
words.en: The interior of something is the inside part of it.

words.ex: The children sat on the eaves to watch the rain.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们坐在屋檐下看雨。
words.en: The part of a roof that meets or overhangs the walls of a building.

words.ex: She wore the shirt loosely over her jeans.
words.ex_cn: 她宽松地把衬衫穿在牛仔裤外面。
words.en: In a way that is not firmly or tightly fixed in place; not strictly or precisely.

words.ex: The foundation gives money to poor students.
words.ex_cn: 这个基金会向贫困学生提供资金。
words.en: The foundation of something such as a belief or way of life is the things on which it is based.

words.ex: He will fasten his seatbelt before driving.
words.ex_cn: 他开车前会系好安全带。
words.en: To close or attach something firmly so that it will not open or come loose.

words.tr: phrase. 中心支柱；核心支持；中央柱
words.ex: The central pillar of the bridge supports the entire structure.
words.ex_cn: n. 桥梁的中心支柱支撑着整个结构。
words.en: The main support or most important part of something.

words.ex: The machine purifies water by removing dirt.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器通过去除杂质来净化水。
words.en: To purify something means to make it clean and pure by removing dirty or harmful substances from it.

words.ex: He grew up in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他是在农村长大的。
words.en: The countryside refers to the land and scenery of a rural area, often characterized by farms, fields, and small villages, away from urban centers.

words.ex: He concluded that the experiment failed.
words.ex_cn: 他得出结论说实验失败了。
words.en: If you conclude that something is true, you decide that it is true using the facts you know as a basis.

words.ex: Children have reliance on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子依赖父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: Reliance is the state of depending on or trusting in someone or something.

words.ex: He will initiate a new project next week.
words.ex_cn: 他将在下周发起一个新项目。
words.en: To initiate something means to start it or cause it to happen.

words.tr: adj. 难以达到的；无法接近的；
words.ex: The mountain peak is inaccessible in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这座山峰在冬天难以到达。
words.en: If a place is inaccessible, it is very difficult or impossible to reach or enter.

words.ex: The distribution of students in the class is even.
words.ex_cn: 班级里学生的分布是均匀的。
words.en: The process of giving out or spreading something, or the way in which something is spread or arranged over an area or among a group of people.

words.ex: This district has many parks and schools.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有许多公园和学校。
words.en: A district is a part of a city, country, or other area that has been officially designated for a particular purpose, such as administration or business.

words.ex: The package includes a free book.
words.ex_cn: 这个套餐包括一本免费的书。
words.en: If one thing includes another, it has the other thing as one of its parts.

words.tr: adj. 包容的；包含全部费用的；
words.ex: The school is inclusive and welcomes all students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校是包容的，欢迎所有学生。
words.en: Inclusive is used to describe something that is designed to include all types of people, things, or ideas, and to treat them all fairly and equally.

words.ex: The project involves simple math and writing.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目包括简单的数学和写作。
words.en: If a situation or activity involves something, that thing is a necessary part or consequence of it.

words.tr:
n. 首都；财富；大写字母；
adj. 大写的；
words.ex: Beijing is the capital of China.
words.ex_cn: 北京是中国的首都。
words.en: The city or town that functions as the seat of government and administrative center of a country or region.

words.ex: The footbridge connects the two sides of the river.
words.ex_cn: 这座人行桥连接了河的两岸。
words.en: A footbridge is a narrow bridge for pedestrians.

words.ex: He held the handrail while walking down the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 他下楼梯时扶着扶手。
words.en: A handrail is a rail that you can hold onto for support, for example when you are going up or down stairs.

words.ex: The truck carried boxes to the store.
words.ex_cn: 卡车把箱子运到了商店。
words.en: A truck is a large vehicle that is used to transport goods by road.

words.ex: This phone is affordable for students.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机对学生来说价格合理。
words.en: If something is affordable, most people have enough money to buy it.

words.ex: Rain can hinder our plan to go hiking.
words.ex_cn: 雨天会妨碍我们去徒步旅行的计划。
words.en: If something hinders you, it makes it more difficult for you to do something or make progress.

words.ex: The government will implement new rules next month.
words.ex_cn: 政府下个月将实施新规定。
words.en: To implement something means to ensure that what has been planned is done.

words.tr: v. 觅食；给……提供食物（forage 的现在分词...；
words.ex: Birds are foraging for worms in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在花园里觅食虫子。
words.en: Foraging is the act of searching for food or provisions.

words.ex: He wrote an essay about his summer trip.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于他暑假旅行的文章。
words.en: An essay is a short piece of writing on a particular subject.

words.ex: The farmer feeds his livestock every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂他的家畜。
words.en: Livestock are animals such as cattle and sheep which are kept on a farm.

words.tr: adj. 可食用的；可以吃的；
words.ex: These mushrooms are edible and safe to eat.
words.ex_cn: 这些蘑菇是可食用的，安全可以吃。
words.en: Fit to be eaten as food.

words.ex: He converts old paper into new notebooks.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧纸张转换成新笔记本。
words.en: To change something into a different form or to change someone's beliefs, especially their religious beliefs.

words.tr: n. 群体；殖民地；聚居地；
words.ex: A colony of ants moved quickly across the ground.
words.ex_cn: 一群蚂蚁迅速从地上爬过。
words.en: A colony is a country or area that is under the political control of another country, usually one that is far away, and where people from that country live.

words.tr: n. 蚜虫( aphid的名词复数 )
words.ex: The ladybugs eat aphids on the roses.
words.ex_cn: 瓢虫吃玫瑰上的蚜虫。
words.en: Aphids are small insects that feed on the sap of plants, often causing damage to crops.

words.tr: n. 植物纤维质；纤维素；
words.ex: Trees contain a lot of cellulose in their walls.
words.ex_cn: 树木的细胞壁中含有大量的植物纤维质。
words.en: Cellulose is a substance that exists in the cell walls of plants and is used to make paper, textiles, and explosives.

words.tr: n. 杂交；杂种繁殖； v. “interbreed”的现在分词；
words.ex: The interbreeding of two dog breeds created a new type.
words.ex_cn: 两种狗的杂交产生了一种新类型。
words.en: The act of breeding animals or plants of different varieties or species to produce hybrids.

words.tr: n. 霉菌；菌类；真菌；“fungus”的复数；
words.ex: The bread has fungi growing on it.
words.ex_cn: 面包上长了霉菌。
words.en: Fungi are a group of living organisms which are classified in their own kingdom. This means they are not animals, plants, or bacteria. Fungi include mushrooms, molds, and yeasts.

words.tr: n. 血液变体；血型变异
words.ex: The lab tested his blood-variants to find a match.
words.ex_cn: 实验室检测了他的血型变体以寻找匹配。
words.en: Different types or groups of blood, often in a medical or genetic context.

words.ex: He went to the dental clinic for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去牙科诊所做检查。
words.en: Relating to the teeth or to the work of a dentist.

words.ex: The cave paintings are prehistoric.
words.ex_cn: 这些洞穴壁画是史前的。
words.en: Belonging to or existing in times before recorded history.

words.tr: adj. 长期存在的；经久不衰的
words.ex: They have a long-standing friendship.
words.ex_cn: 他们有着长久的友谊。
words.en: Existing or continuing for a long time.

words.tr: phrase. 牙科标本；牙科样本
words.ex: The museum has a collection of dental specimens from the 19th century.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆收藏有19世纪的牙科标本。
words.en: Dental specimens refer to samples or examples of teeth or dental structures used for study or display.

words.tr: n. 亲密；接近；密闭；狭窄
words.ex: The closeness of the two friends is obvious.
words.ex_cn: 这两位朋友之间的亲密显而易见。
words.en: The state of being close in space or time; intimacy or familiarity.

words.ex: The dark clouds indicate rain.
words.ex_cn: 乌云表明要下雨了。
words.en: If one thing indicates another, the first thing shows that the second is true or exists.

words.ex: The rule excludes children under 12.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则排除了12岁以下的孩子。
words.en: To exclude someone or something means to prevent them from entering a place or taking part in an activity.

words.ex: The fence marks the boundary between the two gardens.
words.ex_cn: 这道围栏标志着两个花园的分界线。
words.en: A boundary is a real or imagined line that marks the edge or limit of something.

words.tr:
v. 保存；保护；保持；
n. （某群体）专有的活动；
words.ex: She preserves fresh fruit by making jam.
words.ex_cn: 她通过做果酱来保存新鲜水果。
words.en: To preserve something means to maintain it in its original or existing state.

words.ex: She has traveled extensively across Europe.
words.ex_cn: 她广泛地游历了欧洲。
words.en: Something that is extensive covers a wide range of details, ideas, or items.

words.ex: The teacher monitors the students' progress each week.
words.ex_cn: 老师每周监控学生的进步。
words.en: A monitor is a machine that is used to check or record things, for example in a factory or hospital. In a school, a monitor is a student who helps the teacher with various duties.

words.ex: The teacher will allocate books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将给学生分配书籍。
words.en: To allocate something means to give it to a particular person or use it for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The imbalance in income causes social problems.
words.ex_cn: 收入的失衡导致了社会问题。
words.en: An imbalance is a situation in which the elements or forces involved are not equal in strength or importance, leading to a lack of equilibrium.

words.ex: The lake is undergoing acidification from pollution.
words.ex_cn: 湖泊因污染而发生酸化。
words.en: The process of becoming acid or being converted into an acid.

words.ex: Plants need nitrogen to grow.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要氮来生长。
words.en: A chemical element with the symbol N and atomic number 7. It is a colorless, odorless, tasteless gas that is the most plentiful element in Earth's atmosphere and is a constituent of all living tissues.

words.ex: Sulphur smells like rotten eggs.
words.ex_cn: 硫磺闻起来像臭鸡蛋。
words.en: Sulphur is a yellow chemical element that is found in various forms and is used in industry and medicine.

words.ex: He made a proposal to improve the school lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个改善学校午餐的提案。
words.en: A proposal is a plan or suggestion, especially a formal one that is put forward for people to think about and decide upon.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built pyramids for their kings.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人为他们的国王建造了金字塔。
words.en: A pyramid is a monumental structure with a square or triangular base and sloping sides that meet in a point at the top, especially one built of stone as a royal tomb in ancient Egypt.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians used hieroglyph to write messages.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人用象形文字来书写信息。
words.en: A hieroglyph is a character of the ancient Egyptian writing system, which consists of pictures or symbols representing words or sounds.

words.tr:
adj. 埃及的；
n. 埃及语；
words.ex: She bought an Egyptian scarf at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买了一条埃及风格的围巾。
words.en: Of or relating to Egypt or its people, language, or culture.

words.ex: The boy is flying a kite in the park.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在公园里放风筝。
words.en: A kite is a toy consisting of a light frame covered with paper, cloth, or plastic, which you fly in the air at the end of one or more long strings. It is also a bird of prey with long pointed wings and a forked tail.

words.ex: The boy resembles his father.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩长得像他父亲。
words.en: If one thing or person resembles another, they are similar to each other.

words.ex: He will rename the file tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会重命名这个文件。
words.en: To give a new name to someone or something.

words.tr:
adj. 依靠的；依赖的；
n. 受赡养者；
words.ex: The child is dependent on his parents for food.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子依靠父母提供食物。
words.en: A dependent person or thing is one that needs the support of another person or thing in order to exist or be successful.

words.ex: The sockeye salmon is known for its bright red color.
words.ex_cn: 红鲑鱼以其鲜红的颜色而闻名。
words.en: A sockeye is a small salmon with red flesh, found in the northern Pacific Ocean and rivers draining into it.

words.tr: phrase. 粉鲑（一种体型较小、肉呈粉红色的太平洋鲑鱼）
words.ex: We caught a pink salmon during our fishing trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们在钓鱼旅行中捕获了一条粉红鲑鱼。
words.en: A small salmon with a light pink flesh, found in the northern Pacific Ocean and valued as food.

words.ex: The fish spawn in the river each spring.
words.ex_cn: 鱼每年春天在河里产卵。
words.en: To spawn means to produce or deposit eggs, especially in large quantities, as fish, frogs, etc. do. It can also mean to give rise to or generate something.

words.ex: He works hard to earn his subsistence.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以维持生计。
words.en: Subsistence is the condition of just having enough food or money to stay alive.

words.ex: The two countries signed a treaty for peace.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了和平条约。
words.en: Peace is a situation or a period of time in which there is no war or violence in a country or an area.

words.ex: The children were exposed to cold weather without coats.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在没有外套的情况下遭受了寒冷天气。
words.en: To expose something means to uncover it so that it can be seen, or to make it known or public.

words.ex: The movie caused a strong arousal of emotions.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影唤起了强烈的情感。
words.en: Arousal is the state of being awake or of reacting to stimuli; it can also refer to the act of arousing someone or something.

words.tr:
v. 爆裂；突然而起；
n. 爆裂；突然而起；
words.ex: The balloon burst when he blew too much air.
words.ex_cn: 当他吹入太多空气时，气球爆裂了。
words.en: If something bursts or if you burst it, it suddenly breaks open or splits open and the air or other substance inside it comes out; used especially to describe the sound of something breaking open.

words.ex: The controller turns the machine on and off.
words.ex_cn: 控制者打开和关闭机器。
words.en: A controller is a device or mechanism that manages or regulates the operation of a machine or system.

words.ex: He will repeat the question.
words.ex_cn: 他会重复这个问题。
words.en: To say or write something again, either once or several times.

words.ex: Under these circumstances, we had to cancel the trip.
words.ex_cn: 在这种情况下，我们不得不取消旅行。
words.en: A circumstance is a fact or event that makes a situation the way it is.

words.ex: The weather was predictable today, just like yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气和昨天一样，是可以预见的。
words.en: If you say that an event or a situation is predictable, you mean that it is obvious in advance that it will happen or what it will be like.

words.ex: He is doing proofreading for his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为他的文章做校对。
words.en: Proofreading is the activity of finding and correcting mistakes in text before it is printed or put online.

words.tr:
adj. 完整的；完成的；
v. 完成；
words.ex: The book is complete with all chapters.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有所有章节，是完整的。
words.en: If you complete something, you finish doing, making, or producing it.

words.ex: His sadness manifested in his quiet eyes.
words.ex_cn: 他的悲伤表现在他安静的眼神中。
words.en: To manifest something means to show it clearly and visibly.

words.ex: The irritation on his arm hurt when he touched it.
words.ex_cn: 他手臂上的疼痛处一碰就疼。
words.en: Irritation is the feeling of annoyance, especially when something keeps happening that you do not like.

words.ex: You must concentrate on your homework.
words.ex_cn: 你必须集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you concentrate on something, you give it your full attention and think about it carefully.

words.ex: He showed great concentration while solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解这道数学题时非常专注。
words.en: Concentration is the ability to focus all your attention on one thing without being distracted.

words.ex: The scientist observe the birds every morning.
words.ex_cn: 科学家每天早上观察鸟类。
words.en: If you observe a person or thing, you watch them carefully, especially in order to learn something about them.

words.ex: The worker had long exposure to loud noise.
