words.ex_cn: 这名工人长期暴露在噪音中。
words.en: The condition of being exposed to something, especially to something harmful or unpleasant.

words.ex: He will perform the task tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会执行这个任务。
words.en: To perform means to carry out, accomplish, or fulfill an action, task, or function. It can also refer to the act of presenting a form of entertainment, such as a play, concert, or other artistic expression, before an audience.

words.ex: He has the capacity to solve hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: The capacity of a place or container is the amount of things or people that it can hold.

words.ex: They will carry out the experiment tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将进行这个实验。
words.en: To perform or complete a task, duty, or project.

words.tr:
n. 编年史；年代记
v. 按时间顺序记录
words.ex: He writes a chronicle of his daily life.
words.ex_cn: 他记录自己每天的生活。
words.en: A chronicle is a historical account of events arranged in chronological order, typically without analysis or interpretation.

words.ex: He is good at timekeeping during races.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中很擅长计时。
words.en: The act or process of measuring and recording time.

words.ex: The pendulum swings back and forth in the clock.
words.ex_cn: 钟摆在钟里来回摆动。
words.en: A pendulum is a weight that is hung from a fixed point so that it can swing freely, especially a rod with a weight at the end that regulates the mechanism of a clock.

words.ex: The two events happened simultaneously.
words.ex_cn: 这两个事件同时发生了。
words.en: Happening, existing, or done at the same time.

words.ex: He devised a new way to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他设计了一种解决这个问题的新方法。
words.en: To devise something means to plan or invent a new way of doing something.

words.ex: He halved the cake into two equal parts.
words.ex_cn: 他把蛋糕切成两等份。
words.en: To halve something means to divide it into two equal parts, or to reduce it by half.

words.tr: n. 擒纵机构；擒纵轮；擒纵装置；
words.ex: The clock's escapement controls the movement of the gears.
words.ex_cn: 钟表的擒纵机构控制齿轮的运动。
words.en: A mechanism in a clock or watch that controls the speed of the gear train and thus the movement of the hands, or any similar mechanism that controls movement.

words.tr:
v. 成弧线；
n. 弧；弧形物；
words.ex: The rainbow arcs across the sky.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹在天空中形成一道弧线。
words.en: An arc is a smoothly curving line or movement.

words.ex: The boy disobeyed his mother.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩违抗了他妈妈。
words.en: If you disobey someone or something, you deliberately do not do what they say or what they tell you to do.

words.tr: n. 航空；航空学；飞行（术）；
words.ex: He works in aviation as a pilot.
words.ex_cn: 他作为一名飞行员从事航空工作。
words.en: Aviation is the operation and production of aircraft.

words.ex: The two events happened at the same time, but it was coincidental.
words.ex_cn: 这两个事件同时发生，但只是巧合。
words.en: Coincidental means happening by a lucky chance; occurring or existing at the same time or place without planning.

words.ex: The article's over-simplified analysis failed to capture the complexity of the issue.
words.ex_cn: 这篇文章过度简化的分析未能捕捉到问题的复杂性。
words.en: If you describe something as over-simplified, you mean that it is so simple that it fails to deal with the real complexities of the situation or problem.

words.ex: The drone cannot fly in this airspace without permission.
words.ex_cn: 没有许可，无人机不能飞入这个空域。
words.en: The part of the atmosphere that is above a particular country and is considered to belong to that country.

words.ex: The jet engine makes the plane fly fast.
words.ex_cn: 喷气发动机让飞机飞得很快。
words.en: A jet engine is a type of reaction engine discharging a fast-moving jet that generates thrust by jet propulsion.

words.tr: n. 指路明灯；灯塔( beacon的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The lighthouse served as beacons for ships at night.
words.ex_cn: 灯塔在夜晚为船只指路。
words.en: Lights or signals used to guide or warn, especially at sea.

words.tr: adj. 闪烁的； v. “flash”的现在分词；
words.ex: The flashing light warned drivers to stop.
words.ex_cn: 闪烁的灯提醒司机停车。
words.en: A flashing light is one that shines brightly for a short time and then stops shining, then shines again, and so on.

words.tr: n. 心灵感应；传心术；通灵术；
words.ex: He claimed he had telepathy and could read my mind.
words.ex_cn: 他声称自己有心灵感应，能读出我的想法。
words.en: Telepathy is the direct communication of thoughts or feelings between people's minds, without the need for speech or writing.

words.ex: He does meditation every morning to relax.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上冥想以放松。
words.en: Meditation is the act of remaining in a silent and calm state for a period of time, as part of a religious training, or so that you are more able to deal with the problems of everyday life.

words.ex: The dark clouds indicate rain.
words.ex_cn: 乌云表明要下雨了。
words.en: If one thing indicates another, the first thing shows that the second is true or exists.

words.ex: He is researching parapsychology to understand telepathy.
words.ex_cn: 他正在研究超心理学以理解心灵感应。
words.en: The study of mental phenomena that are excluded from or inexplicable by orthodox scientific psychology.

words.ex: The new policy drastically reduced costs.
words.ex_cn: 新政策大幅度降低了成本。
words.en: In a way that is likely to have a strong or far-reaching effect.

words.ex: The doctor ran a trial to test the new medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生进行了试验来测试这种新药。
words.en: A trial is a formal meeting in a law court, at which a judge and jury listen to evidence and decide whether a person is guilty of a crime.

words.ex: He picked a random number to win the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他随意选了一个数字来赢得奖品。
words.en: If you describe something as random, you mean that it happens or is chosen without any definite plan, pattern, or purpose.

words.tr: adj. （中和视听等外界刺激因素的） 超感官知觉全域试验的
words.ex: He experienced a ganzfeld effect during the sensory deprivation test.
words.ex_cn: 他在感觉剥夺测试中经历了全视野效应。
words.en: A technique used in parapsychology experiments to test for extrasensory perception, involving the use of a uniform, featureless visual field and white noise to eliminate sensory input.

words.ex: He will alter the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会改动计划。
words.en: To alter something means to change it, usually slightly, or to cause the characteristics of something to change.

words.tr:
adj. 不停的；直达的；
adv. 不停地；直达地；
words.ex: The train makes a nonstop journey from Beijing to Shanghai.
words.ex_cn: 这列火车从北京到上海是不停站的。
words.en: If something is nonstop, it continues without any pauses or interruptions.

words.tr: phrase. 浮法工艺（指玻璃制造中将熔融玻璃倒入锡槽中形成平整表面的生产工艺）
words.ex: The float process helps clean the water.
words.ex_cn: 漂浮过程有助于净化水。
words.en: A method or procedure that is temporary or easily changed.

words.tr: phrase. 浮动植物；漂浮植物（指能在水面上漂浮生长的植物）
words.ex: The float plant is commonly found in ponds and slow-moving water bodies.
words.ex_cn: 浮水植物常见于池塘和缓慢流动的水体中。
words.en: A float plant is a type of aquatic plant that floats on the surface of the water without being anchored to the bottom.

words.tr: 动名词短语. 检测故障；发现缺陷
words.ex: The technician is detecting faults in the electrical system.
words.ex_cn: 技术人员正在检测电气系统中的故障。
words.en: The act of discovering or identifying problems or defects in a system or machine.

words.ex: He can deduce the answer from the clues.
words.ex_cn: 他能从线索中推断出答案。
words.en: If you deduce something or deduce that something is true, you reach that conclusion because of other things that you know to be true.

words.ex: Glaciers are melting because of global warming.
words.ex_cn: 冰川因全球变暖而融化。
words.en: A glacier is a large, slow-moving mass of ice, formed from compacted layers of snow, that slowly deforms and flows in response to gravity.

words.ex: The teacher gave different interpretations of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 老师对这首诗给出了不同的解释。
words.en: The act of explaining or making clear the meaning of something.

words.ex: The old house had strong odours of damp wood.
words.ex_cn: 这所老房子有强烈的潮湿木头的气味。
words.en: Odours refer to smells, especially those that are strong or unpleasant.

words.ex: He reject the job offer.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝了这份工作邀请。
words.en: If you reject something such as a proposal, a request, or an offer, you do not accept it or you do not agree to it.

words.ex: The limitations of the machine make it slow.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的局限性让它很慢。
words.en: Limitations refer to the act of limiting or the state of being limited; a restriction.

words.ex: He refused the money purely because it was wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他纯粹是因为觉得不对才拒绝了那笔钱。
words.en: In a pure manner; without admixture or adulteration.

words.tr: adj. 无害的；不触犯人的；不讨厌的
words.ex: He gave an inoffensive answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个无害的回答。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as inoffensive, you mean that they are not unpleasant or unacceptable in any way.

words.ex: The lightning struck the tree last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚闪电击中了那棵树。
words.en: A flash of light in the sky caused by the discharge of atmospheric electricity from one cloud to another or between a cloud and the earth.

words.ex: The opposition to the new law was strong.
words.ex_cn: 对这项新法律的反对很强烈。
words.en: Opposition is strong disagreement with or resistance to something, especially a plan, policy, or government.

words.ex: The process of ionisation creates charged particles in the gas.
words.ex_cn: 离子化过程会在气体中产生带电粒子。
words.en: The process by which an atom or a molecule gains or loses electrons, thus acquiring a net charge.

words.tr: n. 电子( electron的名词复数 )
words.ex: Electrons move around the nucleus of an atom.
words.ex_cn: 电子在原子核周围运动。
words.en: Negatively charged subatomic particles that orbit the nucleus of an atom.

words.tr: n. 梁；桁；“beam”的复数； v. 发射电波；“beam”的复数；
words.ex: The bridge is supported by strong steel beams.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥由坚固的钢梁支撑。
words.en: 1. A beam is a line of light that shines from a bright object. 2. A beam is a long thick bar of wood, metal, or concrete that is used to support the roof or floor of a building. 3. If you beam, you smile broadly.

words.tr: n. 指那些能够消除或控制云层的设备或技术，通常用于天气控制或军事用途
words.ex: The kids laughed at the cloud-zappers in the cartoon.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在卡通里笑那些云朵清除器。
words.en: Devices or systems designed to eliminate or neutralize clouds, often in a speculative or fictional context.

words.ex: The ions in the solution carry electric charge.
words.ex_cn: 溶液中的离子带有电荷。
words.en: An ion is an atom or molecule with a net electric charge due to the loss or gain of one or more electrons.

words.tr:
n. 预测；预报；
v. 预测；预报；
words.ex: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 天气预测说明天会下雨。
words.en: If you forecast future events, you say what you think is going to happen in the future.

words.ex: He worked intensely to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他强烈地工作以完成这个项目。
words.en: If something is intense, it is very great or extreme in strength or degree.

words.ex: He is a genius in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面是个天才。
words.en: Someone who is a genius is a person who is exceptionally intelligent or talented, especially in a particular field.

words.tr: adj. 筋疲力尽的；耗尽的； v. 耗尽；用完；“exhaust”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was exhausted after running five kilometers.
words.ex_cn: 他跑完五公里后筋疲力尽。
words.en: If you are exhausted, you are very tired and have no energy left.

words.ex: He inherited a house from his father.
words.ex_cn: 他从父亲那里继承了一所房子。
words.en: If you inherit something such as a trait, characteristic, or quality, you are born with it, because your parents or ancestors had it. If you inherit money or property, you receive it from someone who has died.

words.ex: The letter revealed his secret.
words.ex_cn: 这封信揭露了他的秘密。
words.en: To reveal something means to make known something that was previously secret or unknown.

words.ex: His upbringing taught him to be honest and kind.
words.ex_cn: 他的抚育让他学会了诚实和善良。
words.en: The way that a child is cared for and taught how to behave while it is growing up.

words.ex: The uniqueness of her voice made her famous.
words.ex_cn: 她声音的唯一性让她成名。
words.en: The quality of being the only one of its kind.

words.ex: He is capable of solving hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: If a person or thing is capable of doing something, they have the ability or potential to do it.

words.ex: He showed excellence in math competitions.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学竞赛中表现出色。
words.en: The quality of being outstanding or extremely good.

words.ex: The boy is a piano prodigy at age six.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩六岁时就是一位钢琴奇才。
words.en: A prodigy is someone who is unusually young and has a great natural ability in a particular area.

words.ex: The essence of love is caring for others.
words.ex_cn: 爱的本质是关心他人。
words.en: The essence of something is its basic and most important characteristic which gives it its individual identity.

words.ex: He deserves a break after working so hard.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作后值得休息一下。
words.en: If you say that a person or thing deserves something, you mean that they should have it or receive it because of their actions or qualities.

words.tr: adj. 正确的；合适的；正当的；
words.ex: This is the proper way to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是解决这个问题的正确方法。
words.en: If something is proper, it is suitable or correct for a particular purpose, situation, or person.

words.ex: He is prolonging the meeting by asking many questions.
words.ex_cn: 他通过问很多问题来延长会议。
words.en: To extend the duration of something; to make something last longer.

words.ex: The decision was made in accordance with the rules.
words.ex_cn: 这个决定是按照规则做出的。
words.en: Agreement or harmony; conformity.

words.tr: n. 突变；变化；转变；转变（mutation 的复数形式）；
words.ex: The mutations in the virus made it spread faster.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒的突变使其传播得更快。
words.en: Changes in the genetic material of cells that can lead to variations in the organism.

words.ex: We should conserve water in daily life.
words.ex_cn: 我们应在日常生活中节约用水。
words.en: To conserve something means to protect it from harm, loss, or change, especially in order to preserve it for the future.

words.tr: n. 对应物；相当之物；副本；
words.ex: The CEO's counterpart in China signed the agreement.
words.ex_cn: 中国方面的对应人物签署了协议。
words.en: Someone's or something's counterpart is another person or thing that has a similar function or position in a different place.

words.ex: His attainment of the goal took many years.
words.ex_cn: 他达到这个目标花了多年时间。
words.en: The act of achieving something, especially through effort; a skill or accomplishment that has been achieved.

words.ex: He loves mathematics because it is logical.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学，因为它有逻辑性。
words.en: Mathematics is the study of numbers, shapes, and patterns using reason and usually a special system of symbols and rules for organizing them.

words.ex: The new house has a spacious living room.
words.ex_cn: 这所新房子有一个宽敞的客厅。
words.en: A spacious room, building, or place is large in size or area, so that you can move around freely in it.

words.ex: The school is state-run and free for all children.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校是国营的，所有孩子都可以免费就读。
words.en: State-run refers to something that is owned and operated by the government.

words.ex: The rain and the thunder happened in conjunction.
words.ex_cn: 雨和雷声同时发生。
words.en: A conjunction is a word that is used to connect clauses or sentences or to coordinate words in the same clause.

words.tr: n. 工作表；活页练习题；
words.ex: The teacher gave the students math worksheets for homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师给学生发了数学工作表作为家庭作业。
words.en: Sheets of paper or digital documents containing exercises or tasks for students to complete.

words.ex: Many students take supplementary tuition to improve their grades.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生参加补充教学以提高成绩。
words.en: Additional teaching or instruction provided to students outside of their regular curriculum to help them understand the material better or to improve their academic performance.

words.ex: The job is repetitive and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作重复且无聊。
words.en: Something that is repetitive involves doing the same thing over and over again.

words.ex: Farmers use pesticide to kill insects on crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用杀虫剂来杀死作物上的昆虫。
words.en: A pesticide is a chemical substance used to kill pests, especially insects, that damage crops or are harmful to human health.

words.ex: He studies ecology to understand how animals live with plants.
words.ex_cn: 他学习生态学以了解动物如何与植物共存。
words.en: Ecology is the study of the relationships between living organisms, including humans, and their physical environment; it seeks to understand the vital connections between plants and animals and the world around them.

words.ex: Agroecologists study the interactions between plants, animals, humans and the environment within agricultural systems.
words.ex_cn: 农业生态学家研究农业系统中植物、动物、人类和环境之间的相互作用。
words.en: Agroecologists are scientists who study the ecological processes that operate in agricultural production systems.

words.ex: The farmer tried to kill the pest with a spray.
words.ex_cn: 农民试图用喷雾杀死害虫。
words.en: A pest is an animal or insect that damages crops, food, or livestock, or is generally troublesome. It can also refer to a person or thing that causes annoyance or trouble.

words.tr:
n. 瘟疫；疫病；
v. 困扰；折磨；
words.ex: The plague killed many people in medieval Europe.
words.ex_cn: 瘟疫在中世纪的欧洲杀死了许多人。
words.en: A plague is a very infectious disease that spreads quickly and kills a lot of people. It can also refer to a large number of insects or animals that cause damage or are a nuisance.

words.tr:
v. 意思；导致；打算；
n. 平均数；
adj. 低劣；平均；
words.ex: What does this word mean?
words.ex_cn: 这个词是什么意思？
words.en: If you want to know what a word, a sentence, or an expression means, you want to know what it refers to or what its significance is.

words.ex: Babies have an innate ability to cry.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿生来就有哭泣的能力。
words.en: An innate quality or ability is one that you were born with, not one you have learned.

words.ex: Vaccines help build immunity against diseases.
words.ex_cn: 疫苗有助于增强对疾病的免疫力。
words.en: Immunity is the state of being immune from or insusceptible to a particular disease or the legal status of being exempt from certain obligations or penalties.

words.ex: The shirt is made of synthetic fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫是合成纤维制成的。
words.en: Synthetic products are made from chemicals or artificial substances rather than from natural ones.

words.ex: The dogs had three offspring last spring.
words.ex_cn: 这些狗去年春天生了三只幼崽。
words.en: Someone's offspring are their children.

words.ex: Under these circumstances, we had to cancel the trip.
words.ex_cn: 在这种情况下，我们不得不取消旅行。
words.en: A circumstance is a fact or event that makes a situation the way it is.

words.ex: He wiped out the board with a cloth.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块布把板擦掉了。
words.en: To completely destroy, remove, or eliminate something or someone.

words.tr:
v. 搜寻；（动物）觅食；
n. 饲料；草料；
words.ex: The bear forages for berries in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这只熊在森林里搜寻浆果。
words.en: If you forage, you search for food or other supplies. Forage can also refer to food for animals, especially when it is grown or collected.

words.tr: phrase. 椰子树（热带地区常见的高大棕榈树，结椰子果实）
words.ex: Coconut trees are commonly found in tropical regions.
words.ex_cn: 椰子树常见于热带地区。
words.en: Coconut trees are tall palm trees that produce coconuts, commonly found in tropical coastal areas.

words.ex: She planted a hyacinth in her garden.
words.ex_cn: 她在花园里种了一株风信子。
words.en: A hyacinth is a plant with sweet-smelling flowers that grow closely together around a single stem. It can also refer to a precious stone, especially a blue variety of zircon.

words.ex: Parthenium is a genus of flowering plants in the aster family.
words.ex_cn: 银胶菊属是菊科中的一个开花植物属。
words.en: Parthenium is a genus of flowering plants in the aster family, Asteraceae. It includes species that are commonly known as feverfew and wild quinine.

words.tr: phrase. 幼虫期寄生虫；处于幼虫阶段的寄生生物
words.ex: The scientist studied the larval parasites found in the river.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究了在河中发现的幼虫寄生虫。
words.en: Larval parasites refer to the immature forms of parasites that live on or in a host organism, often causing harm.

words.ex: The scientist used taxonomic keys to identify the plant.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家使用分类学钥匙来识别这种植物。
words.en: Relating to the classification of organisms in an ordered system that indicates natural relationships.

words.ex: The main criterion for winning is fairness.
words.ex_cn: 获胜的主要标准是公平。
words.en: A criterion is a principle or standard by which something may be judged or decided.

words.ex: The scientist examined the specimens under a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 科学家在显微镜下检查了这些标本。
words.en: A specimen is a single example of something, such as a plant, animal, or mineral, that is used as a typical example of its kind.

words.ex: He drinks nonalcoholic beer at parties.
words.ex_cn: 他在聚会上喝无酒精啤酒。
words.en: Not containing alcohol.

words.ex: Bread often contains a preservative to last longer.
words.ex_cn: 面包中常含有防腐剂以延长保质期。
words.en: A preservative is a chemical that is added to substances such as food, wood, or medicine to prevent them from decaying or spoiling.

words.ex: He will enrol in the English course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将登记参加英语课程。
words.en: To officially arrange to join a school, university, or course, or to arrange for someone else to do this.

words.ex: Quinine is used to treat malaria.
words.ex_cn: 奎宁用于治疗疟疾。
words.en: A bitter crystalline compound present in cinchona bark, used as a tonic and formerly to treat malaria.

words.ex: We derive the answer from the formula.
words.ex_cn: 我们从公式中得到答案。
words.en: If you derive something such as pleasure or benefit from a person or from something, you get it from them.

words.ex: Her story inspires me to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 她的故事激励我更加努力。
words.en: If someone or something inspires you to do something new or unusual, they make you want to do it.

words.tr:
adj. 紫色的；
n. 紫色；
words.ex: The flower is purple.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花是紫色的。
words.en: Purple is a color that is a mixture of red and blue.

words.tr:
v. 把…联系在一起；
adj. 副的；
n. 同事；伙伴；
words.ex: He associates happiness with family time.
words.ex_cn: 他把幸福与家庭时光联系在一起。
words.en: If you associate someone or something with a particular quality or idea, or if they are associated with it, you connect them in your mind with that quality or idea.

words.ex: He was newly hired as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他最近被聘为老师。
words.en: Newly means something that has happened or been done recently.

words.ex: This dress is colored with a synthetic dye.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子是用合成染料染色的。
words.en: A synthetic dye is a man-made substance used to add color to materials, differing from natural dyes which are derived from plants or animals.

words.ex: The signal transmission is clear and strong.
words.ex_cn: 信号传输清晰而强劲。
words.en: The act or process of sending or passing something from one place, person, or thing to another.

words.tr: n. 信号；“signal”的复数； v. 预示；
words.ex: The radio receives signals from satellites.
words.ex_cn: 收音机接收来自卫星的信号。
words.en: A signal is a gesture, sound, or action which is intended to give a particular message to the person who sees or hears it.

words.tr: adj. 适当的；合适的；恰当的；
words.ex: This dress is appropriate for a wedding.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子适合参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is appropriate is suitable or acceptable for a particular situation.

words.ex: Ancient Egypt was one of the earliest civilisations.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及是最早的文明之一。
words.en: Civilisation refers to an advanced state of human society, in which a high level of culture, science, industry, and government has been reached.

words.ex: His assumption was that the train would be on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的假设是火车会准时。
words.en: An assumption is something that you assume to be the case, even without proof.

words.tr: adj. 地球外的；地外的；外星球的；
words.ex: The movie shows an extraterrestrial life form.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了一种地球外的生命形式。
words.en: An extraterrestrial is a creature that comes from or exists outside the planet Earth.

words.ex: He has high expectancy for the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来有很高的预期。
words.en: The feeling of excitement about something that is going to happen.

words.ex: The outer door is locked, but the inner one is open.
words.ex_cn: 外门锁着，但内门是开着的。
words.en: Outer is used to describe something that is on the outside of something else.

words.ex: He possesses a small house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有一栋靠近湖边的小房子。
words.en: If you possess something, you have it or own it.

words.tr: n. 鱼龙（已灭绝的海洋爬行动物）
words.ex: Ichthyosaurs were marine reptiles that lived during the time of the dinosaurs.
words.ex_cn: 鱼龙是生活在恐龙时代的海洋爬行动物。
words.en: Ichthyosaurs were large marine reptiles that lived during the Mesozoic era, resembling dolphins in appearance and adapted to a fully aquatic lifestyle.

words.ex: The turtle walks slowly on the sand.
words.ex_cn: 乌龟在沙子上慢慢走。
words.en: A turtle is a reptile with a hard shell that lives in the sea or on land.

words.tr: adj. 不完全的；不完整的；
words.ex: The puzzle is incomplete without the last piece.
words.ex_cn: 没有最后一块，这个拼图是不完全的。
words.en: If something is incomplete, it is not yet finished, or it does not have all the parts that it should have.

words.ex: The dog uses its forelimbs to walk.
words.ex_cn: 狗用它的前肢走路。
words.en: The front limbs of an animal, especially those of a quadruped.

words.ex: The forest is dense with trees.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林树木茂密。
words.en: Something that is dense contains a lot of things or people in a small area.

words.ex: The dark clouds indicate rain.
words.ex_cn: 乌云表明要下雨了。
words.en: If one thing indicates another, the first thing shows that the second is true or exists.

words.ex: The forest looked primeval and untouched.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林看起来远古而未被破坏。
words.en: relating to the earliest ages of the world or the universe; ancient or prehistoric.

words.ex: The transition from school to work was hard for him.
words.ex_cn: 从学校到工作的转变对他来说很难。
words.en: The process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another.

words.ex: He made a hypothesis that plants grow faster in light.
words.ex_cn: 他提出一个假设，认为植物在光照下长得更快。
words.en: A hypothesis is an idea which is suggested as a possible explanation for a particular situation or condition, but which has not yet been proved to be correct.

words.tr:
v. 估算；估价；
n. 估价；估算；
words.ex: Can you estimate how long it will take?
words.ex_cn: 你能估算一下需要多长时间吗？
words.en: If you estimate a quantity or value, you make an approximate judgment or calculation of it.

words.ex: The proportion of students who passed the test was high.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的学生比例很高。
words.en: A proportion is a part of a whole, or the relationship of one part to another in terms of size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: The auditory system helps us hear sounds.
words.ex_cn: 听觉系统帮助我们听到声音。
words.en: Relating to the sense of hearing.

words.ex: Schoolchildren walk to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 学童每天早上走路去学校。
words.en: Schoolchildren are children who attend school.

words.tr: n. 机械（总称）；机械装置；
words.ex: The factory uses old machinery to produce goods.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂使用旧机械来生产产品。
words.en: Machinery refers to machines in general or the parts of a machine that make it work.

words.tr: n. 自闭症；孤独症；自我中心主义；
words.ex: He was diagnosed with autism at age three.
words.ex_cn: 他在三岁时被诊断出患有自闭症。
words.en: Autism is a developmental disorder characterized by difficulties with social interaction and communication, and by restricted and repetitive behavior.

words.tr:
adj. 难过的；沮丧的；
v. 打乱；使心烦；
words.ex: He felt upset when his dog ran away.
words.ex_cn: 当他的狗跑掉时，他感到很难过。
words.en: If you are upset, you are unhappy or disappointed because something unpleasant has happened to you.

words.tr: phrase. 回响的走廊；指声音在走廊中反复回荡的；常用于比喻信息或影响在机构内部传播的情景
words.ex: The echoing corridors made every step sound loud.
words.ex_cn: 回响的走廊让每一步都听起来很响。
words.en: Corridors that produce echoes, often because they are long and empty.

words.ex: He is overly careful with his money.
words.ex_cn: 他花钱过于谨慎。
words.en: To an excessive degree.

words.tr:
n. 模型；模特；模范；型号；
v. 将…做成模型；当模特；
words.ex: The architect built a model of the new building.
words.ex_cn: 建筑师制作了新大楼的模型。
words.en: A model is a person whose job is to wear and show new styles of clothes and other products, or a representation of something, often on a smaller scale, or a particular design or type of product.

words.ex: The parallax makes the star look like it moves.
words.ex_cn: 视差使恒星看起来在移动。
words.en: The apparent displacement or the difference in apparent direction of an object as seen from two different points not on a straight line with the object.

words.ex: He uses an astronomical telescope to watch stars.
words.ex_cn: 他用一架天文望远镜观察星星。
words.en: If you describe an amount, especially the cost of something as astronomical, you are emphasizing that it is very large indeed.

words.ex: The planet Mars is red.
words.ex_cn: 火星是红色的。
words.en: A planet is a large object in space that moves around a star, such as the sun, and does not produce its own light.

words.ex: The transit of goods takes three days.
words.ex_cn: 货物的运输需要三天。
words.en: The act or process of passing through or across; the conveyance of people or goods from one place to another.

words.ex: Venus is the brightest planet in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 金星是夜空中最亮的行星。
words.en: Venus is the second planet from the Sun, orbiting it every 224.7 Earth days. It is named after the Roman goddess of love and beauty.

words.ex: The astronomer looks at stars through a telescope.
words.ex_cn: 这位天文学家通过望远镜观察星星。
words.en: An astronomer is a scientist who studies celestial bodies such as planets, stars, and galaxies.

words.tr: v. 猜想；怀疑；“suspect”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 被怀疑的；
words.ex: I suspected he was lying.
words.ex_cn: 我猜他撒谎了。
words.en: Believed to be guilty of a crime or wrongdoing, but not yet proven.

words.ex: He is studying neuroeconomics to understand how the brain makes decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习神经经济学，以了解大脑如何做决定。
words.en: Neuroeconomics is an interdisciplinary field that combines neuroscience, economics, and psychology to study how people make decisions.

words.tr: n. 攻击传统观念的人；
words.ex: He is an iconoclast who challenges old beliefs.
words.ex_cn: 他是个挑战传统观念的人。
words.en: An iconoclast is someone who criticizes or attacks cherished beliefs or institutions.

words.ex: This painting has a distinctive style.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有独特的风格。
words.en: Something that is distinctive has a special quality or feature which makes it easily recognizable and different from other things of the same type.

words.ex: He interprets the poem as a love story.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首诗解释为一个爱情故事。
words.en: If you interpret something in a particular way, you decide that this is its meaning or significance.

words.tr: adv. 逻辑上；合乎逻辑地；
words.ex: He solved the problem logically.
words.ex_cn: 他逻辑上解决了这个问题。
words.en: In a way that is reasonable and based on good judgment.

words.ex: These photons are the smallest packets of electromagnetic energy.
words.ex_cn: 这些光子是最小的电磁能量包。
words.en: Photons are the elementary particles of light, the quantum of the electromagnetic field including electromagnetic radiation such as light and radio waves, and the force carrier for the electromagnetic force.

words.tr: v. 集中；形成中心；中央集权
words.ex: The government wants to centralise power.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望集中权力。
words.en: To bring under a single central authority or control; to centralize.

words.ex: Children develop perceptual skills by playing with toys.
words.ex_cn: 儿童通过玩玩具发展知觉能力。
words.en: Relating to the ability to interpret or become aware of something through the senses.

words.tr: phrase. 认知陷阱；指人们在思考过程中常见的心理偏差或思维误区，可能导致错误判断或决策
words.ex: People often fall into cognitive traps when making quick decisions.
words.ex_cn: 人们在快速做决定时常常陷入认知陷阱。
words.en: Cognitive traps refer to systematic errors in thinking that can lead to irrational decisions and judgments.

words.ex: His fear of heights is hard-wired from birth.
words.ex_cn: 他对高度的恐惧是与生俱来的。
words.en: If something is hard-wired into a computer or machine, it is built into it and cannot be changed. If a quality or way of behaving is hard-wired into a person or animal, it is a natural part of them that they cannot change.

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.tr: adj. 现实的；现实主义的；
words.ex: He made a realistic plan to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个现实的存钱计划。
words.en: If you are realistic about a situation, you recognize and accept its true nature and try to deal with it in a practical way.

words.ex: He felt embarrassment when he tripped in front of everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他在众人面前绊倒时感到窘迫。
words.en: A feeling of self-consciousness, shame, or awkwardness.

words.tr: n. 有价值的人或物；长处；
words.ex: He is an asset to the team because he works hard.
words.ex_cn: 他是个有价值的人，因为他工作努力。
words.en: An asset is something valuable that an individual, corporation, or country owns or controls with the expectation that it will provide a future benefit.

words.ex: He felt sad after the rejection.
words.ex_cn: 在遭到拒绝后，他感到很难过。
words.en: The act of refusing to accept, believe in, or agree with something.

words.tr: adj. 规定的；指定的；约定俗成的；
words.ex: The teacher gave a prescriptive rule for writing essays.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了一个关于写论文的规定性规则。
words.en: If something is prescriptive, it involves making rules or giving instructions about what should be done.

words.tr: n. 规定主义（指传统语法）
words.ex: He believes in prescriptivism for language rules.
words.ex_cn: 他相信语言规则应该有严格的规定。
words.en: Prescriptivism is the attitude or belief that one variety of a language is superior to others and should be promoted as such, especially in the context of grammar and usage.

words.ex: The argument was pointless.
words.ex_cn: 这个争论毫无意义。
words.en: If you describe something as pointless, you are emphasizing that it has no purpose or is not worth doing.

words.tr: v. 故意对…作错误的报道( misrepresent的过去式和过去分词 )
words.ex: He misrepresented the facts to the judge.
words.ex_cn: 他向法官歪曲了事实。
words.en: To give a false or misleading account of the nature of something.

words.ex: A descriptivist approach to language study focuses on how language is actually used by people.
words.ex_cn: n. 描述主义者的语言研究方法专注于人们实际如何使用语言。
words.en: A descriptivist is someone who believes that language should be described as it is actually used, rather than prescribing how it should be used.

words.ex: The teacher gave an evaluation of the student's work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作业进行了评估。
words.en: An evaluation is a judgment about how good, useful, or successful something is.

words.ex: He wore a formal suit to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一套正式的西装去参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is formal is done or said according to an established or conventional way, especially in an official or serious situation.

words.ex: The closure of the store was sudden.
words.ex_cn: 商店的关闭很突然。
words.en: The act of closing something, or the state of being closed.

words.ex: The people showed resistance against the unfair law.
words.ex_cn: 人们对这项不公平的法律表示抵抗。
words.en: Resistance is the refusal to accept or comply with something; the attempt to prevent something by action or argument.

words.ex: The park is in the vicinity of my house.
words.ex_cn: 公园在我家附近。
words.en: The area or region near or about a place; the surrounding district.

words.ex: The boat travels along the coastline.
words.ex_cn: 船沿着海岸线航行。
words.en: The coastline is the outline of a coast, especially its shape and appearance.

words.tr: phrase. 出售；销售（sell 的过去式和过去分词）
words.ex: He sold his bike last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周卖了他的自行车。
words.en: Past tense and past participle of 'sell'.

words.tr:
adj. 固体的；坚固的；可靠的；
n. 固体；
words.ex: Ice is a solid form of water.
words.ex_cn: 冰是水的固体形式。
words.en: A solid substance or object stays the same shape whether it is in a container or not.

words.ex: The wind turbine spins to make electricity.
words.ex_cn: 风力涡轮机旋转以发电。
words.en: A turbine is a machine or engine which uses a stream of air, gas, water, or steam to turn a wheel and produce power.

words.ex: The extraction of coal harms the environment.
words.ex_cn: 煤炭的开采对环境有害。
words.en: The process of removing or obtaining something from something else.

words.ex: The wind turns the blade of the fan.
words.ex_cn: 风转动了风扇的叶片。
words.en: The flat cutting part of a tool or weapon, such as a knife or sword.

words.ex: The child blew a bubble with gum.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用口香糖吹了一个气泡。
words.en: A bubble is a small ball of air or gas in a liquid, or a ball of air inside a solid substance such as glass.

words.ex: This room is comparatively small.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间相对较小。
words.en: In comparison with something else, especially something similar; relatively.

words.ex: The signal transmission is clear and strong.
words.ex_cn: 信号传输清晰而强劲。
words.en: The act or process of sending or passing something from one place, person, or thing to another.

words.ex: He omitted the last word in the sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他省略了句子中的最后一个词。
words.en: If you omit something, you do not include it in an activity or piece of work, deliberately or accidentally.

words.ex: He became famous for his music and gained great fame.
words.ex_cn: 他因音乐而闻名，获得了巨大的名声。
words.en: the state of being known or talked about by many people, especially on account of notable achievements

words.ex: He is capable of solving hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: If a person or thing is capable of doing something, they have the ability or potential to do it.

words.tr: adj. 不完全的；不完整的；
words.ex: The puzzle is incomplete without the last piece.
words.ex_cn: 没有最后一块，这个拼图是不完全的。
words.en: If something is incomplete, it is not yet finished, or it does not have all the parts that it should have.

words.tr:
n. 探测器；
v. 探查；
words.ex: The probe sent back photos from Mars.
words.ex_cn: 探测器从火星传回了照片。
words.en: If you probe into something, you ask questions or try to discover facts about it. A probe is also a long thin instrument that doctors and dentists use to examine parts of the body.

words.ex: The switchover from old to new system took one day.
words.ex_cn: 从旧系统切换到新系统花了一天时间。
words.en: The act or process of changing from one state, system, or method to another.

words.tr: v. 预料；“anticipate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 预期的；
words.ex: He anticipated the rain and brought an umbrella.
words.ex_cn: 他预料到会下雨，所以带了伞。
words.en: If you anticipate an event, you realize in advance that it may happen and you are prepared for it.

words.ex: He conveyed his thanks with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着表达了谢意。
words.en: If you convey information or a message, you communicate it to someone, often in a way that is not direct.

words.ex: The radioactivity of the material is dangerous.
words.ex_cn: 这种材料的放射性很危险。
words.en: The emission of ionizing radiation or particles caused by the spontaneous disintegration of atomic nuclei.

words.ex: He found uranium in the old rock sample.
words.ex_cn: 他在旧岩石样本中发现了铀。
words.en: A heavy, silvery-white metallic element, radioactive and toxic, used as a fuel in nuclear reactors and in the manufacture of nuclear weapons.

words.ex: The sun gives off radiation.
words.ex_cn: 太阳发出辐射。
words.en: Radiation is energy that comes from a source and travels through space at the speed of light. This energy has an electric field and a magnetic field associated with it, and has wave-like properties. You could also call radiation 'electromagnetic waves'.

words.ex: The necklace is an imitation made of plastic.
words.ex_cn: 这条项链是用塑料做的仿制品。
words.en: An imitation of something is a copy of it.

words.ex: The car remained static at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红灯前静止不动。
words.en: Something that is static does not move or change.

words.ex: He achieved mastery of the piano after ten years of practice.
words.ex_cn: 他经过十年的练习，熟练掌握了钢琴。
words.en: If you show mastery of a particular skill or language, you show that you have learned or understood it completely and have no difficulty using it.

words.tr: adj. 攻击性的；有进取心的；侵略性的；
words.ex: The dog showed aggressive behavior toward strangers.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗对陌生人表现出攻击性行为。
words.en: An aggressive person or animal has a quality of anger and determination that makes them ready to attack others.

words.tr: n. 认可；识别；认识；承认；
words.ex: His hard work got recognition from his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他的努力得到了老板的认可。
words.en: The action or process of recognizing or being recognized, in particular.

words.tr:
n. 纠纷；争端；
v. 对（某事）有异议；
words.ex: The dispute between the two neighbors was about the fence.
words.ex_cn: 两个邻居之间的纠纷是关于篱笆的。
words.en: A dispute is a disagreement or argument about something important.

words.tr:
adj. 当前的；流通的；
n. （水、气、电）流；趋势；
words.ex: The current weather is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 当前的天气非常热。
words.en: belonging to the present time; happening or being used or done now

words.ex: His expectation was to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 他的期待是通过考试。
words.en: An expectation is a belief about what might happen in the future, especially about something that you think is likely or that you hope will happen.

words.ex: The dimension of the box is 10 cm by 5 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的尺寸是10厘米乘5厘米。
words.en: A dimension is a measurement of something in a particular direction, or the scope or scale of something.

words.ex: The attraction of the city draws many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的吸引力吸引了许多游客。
words.en: An attraction is something that makes people want to go to a place or do a particular thing because they are interested in it.

words.ex: He primarily works as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他主要是一名老师。
words.en: You use primarily to say what is mainly true in a particular situation.

words.ex: His involvement in the project helped it succeed.
words.ex_cn: 他参与这个项目帮助它取得了成功。
words.en: The act of taking part in something or the state of being connected with something.

words.tr: v. 反映；反射；反省；思考；仔细考虑；
words.ex: The mirror reflects the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 镜子反射阳光。
words.en: If a surface reflects light, heat, sound, or an image, it sends the light, etc. back and does not absorb it. If something is reflected in a mirror or in water, you can see its image in the mirror or in the water.

words.ex: The conflict between the two countries lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家之间的冲突持续了多年。
words.en: A conflict is a serious disagreement or argument, typically a protracted one.

words.tr: n. 伙伴关系；合作；合作关系；
words.ex: They formed a partnership to run a small shop.
words.ex_cn: 他们建立了一种伙伴关系来经营一家小店。
words.en: A partnership is a legal form of business operation between two or more individuals who share management and profits.

words.ex: The budget is a constraint on our project.
words.ex_cn: 预算是我们项目的限制。
words.en: A constraint is something that limits or controls what you can do.

words.ex: Professionals work hard to help people.
words.ex_cn: 专业人士努力工作来帮助他人。
words.en: People who are qualified in a particular profession or who are engaged in a specific activity as a paid job rather than as a hobby.

words.ex: The letter revealed his secret.
words.ex_cn: 这封信揭露了他的秘密。
words.en: To reveal something means to make known something that was previously secret or unknown.

words.ex: This bag is durable and lasts for years.
words.ex_cn: 这个包很耐用，可以用很多年。
words.en: Something that is durable is strong and lasts a long time without breaking or becoming weaker.

words.tr: v. 使恼怒；使生气；使不悦
words.ex: The loud noise displeases her.
words.ex_cn: 嘈杂的声音让她不高兴。
words.en: If something or someone displeases you, they make you feel annoyed or angry.

words.tr:
n. 荫；阴影；
v. 遮蔽；
words.ex: The tree provides shade on a hot day.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在炎热的日子提供荫凉。
words.en: Shade is an area where there is no direct sunlight, or something that provides protection from the sun. It can also refer to a slight difference in color, or to gradually change from one color or tone to another.

words.ex: I can't find my keys here; they must be elsewhere.
words.ex_cn: 我在这儿找不到我的钥匙，它们一定在别处。
words.en: In or to some other place; not here.

words.tr: v. 恢复；“restore”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 恢复的；复原的；
words.ex: The old house was restored to its original state.
words.ex_cn: 这座老房子被恢复到了原来的状态。
words.en: If something that has been lost or stolen is restored to its owner, it is returned to them.

words.ex: The pattern is geometrical and simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个图案是几何形状的，而且很简单。
words.en: Relating to geometry, or according to its methods and principles.

words.ex: Many pilgrims visit the shrines to pray.
words.ex_cn: 许多朝圣者前往圣地祈祷。
words.en: A shrine is a place of worship which is associated with a particular holy person or object.

words.ex: The wires are intricately connected.
words.ex_cn: 这些电线复杂地连接在一起。
words.en: In a manner that is very complicated or detailed.

words.tr:
n. 委员会；佣金；
v. 委托；
words.ex: The commission met to discuss the new law.
words.ex_cn: 委员会开会讨论新法律。
words.en: A commission is a group of people who have been appointed to find out about something or to control something, or the act of doing this. It can also refer to a sum of money that is paid to someone for selling something, which is usually a percentage of the value of the goods sold.

words.ex: The argument started small but soon escalate.
words.ex_cn: 争论起初很小，但很快逐步升高。
words.en: If a bad situation escalates or if someone or something escalates it, it becomes greater in size, seriousness, or intensity.

words.ex: He will rebalance his portfolio next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将重新调整他的投资组合。
words.en: To adjust the proportions of different elements in a situation or system in order to achieve a desired state of balance again.

words.ex: The car moved at a rapid speed.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车以迅速的速度行驶。
words.en: A rapid change or event happens very quickly.

words.ex: The price is prohibitively high for most people.
words.ex_cn: 这个价格对大多数人来说高得离谱。
words.en: If you say that something is prohibitively expensive, you mean that very few people can afford to buy it or pay for it.

words.ex: He is a candidate for the mayor position.
words.ex_cn: 他是市长职位的候选人。
words.en: A candidate is someone who is being considered for a position, for example someone who is running in an election or applying for a job.

words.ex: The factory reduces emission to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 工厂减少排放以保护环境。
words.en: An emission is the production and discharge of something, especially gas or radiation.

words.ex: The truck carries one tonne of coal.
words.ex_cn: 这辆卡车载着一吨煤。
words.en: A tonne is a unit of weight equal to 1,000 kilograms.

words.tr: n. 四重奏；四重唱；四件一套；
words.ex: The quartet played a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 四重奏在音乐会上演奏了一首美妙的曲子。
words.en: A quartet is a group of four people who play musical instruments or sing together.

words.ex: He was conscious after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后他醒了过来。
words.en: If you are conscious of something, you notice it or are aware of it.

words.ex: The hotel gave us complimentary breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 酒店免费赠送了我们早餐。
words.en: If something is complimentary, it is given or done free of charge. It can also mean expressing a compliment; praising or approving.

words.tr: n. 伙伴关系；合作；合作关系；
words.ex: They formed a partnership to run a small shop.
words.ex_cn: 他们建立了一种伙伴关系来经营一家小店。
words.en: A partnership is a legal form of business operation between two or more individuals who share management and profits.

words.ex: He outperforms his classmates in math tests.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中表现优于同学。
words.en: To perform better than someone or something else.

words.tr:
n. 竞争者；敌手；
v. 竞争；相匹敌；
words.ex: He is my main rival in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他是我在比赛中主要的竞争者。
words.en: A rival is a person, group, or organization that you are competing with in the same activity or the same area.

words.ex: His ambition is to become a president.
words.ex_cn: 他的野心是成为总统。
words.en: An ambition is a strong desire to achieve something, typically requiring determination and hard work.

words.tr:
v. 提到；说到；
n. 提及；说起；
words.ex: He didn't mention the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他没有提到那场事故。
words.en: If you mention something, you say something about it, usually briefly.

words.ex: He eats cereal with milk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃谷类食品配牛奶。
words.en: A cereal is a grass that is cultivated for the edible components of its grain, composed of the endosperm, germ, and bran.

words.ex: Her story inspires me to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 她的故事激励我更加努力。
words.en: If someone or something inspires you to do something new or unusual, they make you want to do it.

words.ex: He gave a concise answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了简明的回答。
words.en: Something that is concise says everything that is necessary without using any unnecessary words.

words.ex: He made a commitment to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺按时完成这个项目。
words.en: A commitment is something that regularly takes up some of your time because of an agreement you have made or because of responsibilities that you have.

words.ex: The dominant color in the room is blue.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间占优势的颜色是蓝色。
words.en: Someone or something that is dominant is more powerful, successful, influential, or noticeable than other people or things.

words.tr: adj. 有（法律）责任的；有…倾向的；
words.ex: He is liable for the damage caused by his car.
words.ex_cn: 他对他的车造成的损害负有责任。
words.en: If you are liable for something such as a debt or a duty, you are legally responsible for it. If something is liable to happen, it is very likely to happen.

words.ex: His speech was persuasive and made everyone agree.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲很有说服力，让所有人都同意了。
words.en: A persuasive argument or reason is one that makes you believe that something is true or right.

words.ex: The country's industrialisation began in the 1950s.
words.ex_cn: 该国的工业化始于20世纪50年代。
words.en: Industrialisation is the process by which an economy is transformed from primarily agricultural to one based on the manufacturing of goods. Individual manual labor is often replaced by mechanized mass production, and craftsmen are replaced by assembly lines.

words.ex: He lives in Holland with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他和家人住在荷兰。
words.en: Holland is a region and former province on the western coast of the Netherlands. The name Holland is also frequently used informally to refer to the whole of the country of the Netherlands.

words.ex: He got dysentery from drinking dirty water.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了脏水后得了痢疾。
words.en: Dysentery is an infection of the intestines that causes severe diarrhea with blood.

words.ex: He drank a glass of malt.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了一杯麦芽饮料。
words.en: Malt is grain, usually barley, that has been soaked in water, allowed to germinate, and then dried. It is used in brewing and distilling.

words.ex: He helped indirectly by giving advice.
words.ex_cn: 他通过提供建议间接地帮忙了。
words.en: In a way that is not direct; not in a straight line or course.

words.ex: The teacher gave me guidance on how to write the essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我写论文的指导。
words.en: Guidance is help and advice that is given to someone about their work, education, or personal life.

words.tr: n. 自立；依靠自己；自力更生
words.ex: He learns self-reliance from living alone.
words.ex_cn: 他通过独自生活学会自立。
words.en: Self-reliance is the ability to do things and make decisions by yourself, without needing other people to help you.

words.ex: The availability of free Wi-Fi is important for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 免费Wi-Fi的可用性对旅行者很重要。
words.en: The quality of being able to be used or obtained.

words.ex: He found an old manuscript in the library.
words.ex_cn: 他在图书馆里发现了一份旧手稿。
words.en: A manuscript is a handwritten or typed document, especially a writer's first version of a book before it is published.

words.ex: The teacher instructed the students to open their books.
words.ex_cn: 老师指示学生打开书。
words.en: To instruct someone means to tell or teach them to do something, especially in a formal or official way.

words.ex: The reproduction of rabbits is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 兔子的生殖速度很快。
words.en: The process of producing offspring or new individuals of the same species, or the act of making a copy of something.

words.ex: The scientist did a replication of the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家重复了这个实验。
words.en: The act of copying or reproducing something.

words.ex: It is regrettable that he missed the train.
words.ex_cn: 他错过了火车，这令人遗憾。
words.en: If you describe something as regrettable, you mean that you think it is bad and that it should not happen or have happened.

words.ex: His superiority in math helped him win the contest.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上的优越让他赢得了比赛。
words.en: If one side in a war or conflict has superiority, it has an advantage over its enemy, for example because it has more soldiers or better equipment.

words.tr:
adj. 大规模的；大量的；
n. 大量；质量；块；群；团；
words.ex: The company launched a mass production line to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 该公司启动了大规模生产线以满足需求。
words.en: A mass is a large amount of something that has no particular shape or arrangement.

words.tr: phrase. 基础思想；根本理念；潜在观念
words.ex: The underlying ideas of the theory are not easy to grasp at first.
words.ex_cn: 这个理论的基本思想一开始不容易理解。
words.en: The fundamental concepts or principles that form the basis of a theory, system, or process.

words.tr:
n. 框架；结构；骨架；模式；
v. 表达；陷害；
words.ex: The picture is in a wooden frame.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画在一个木制框架里。
words.en: A frame is a structure that forms a border or support for something, such as a picture or a window. It can also refer to the process of making or constructing something, or the act of falsely incriminating someone.

words.tr: adj. 不合意的；不想要的；
words.ex: The weather is undesirable for a picnic.
words.ex_cn: 这种天气不适合野餐。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as undesirable, you think they will have harmful effects or cause problems.

words.ex: The teacher criticise the student for not doing homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师批评学生没有做作业。
words.en: If you criticise someone or something, you express your disapproval of them by saying what you think is wrong with them.

words.tr: n. 含意；可能的影响（或后果）；暗示；
words.ex: The implication of his words was that he was sorry.
words.ex_cn: 他话中的含意是他很抱歉。
words.en: An implication is a possible future effect or result of an action or decision, often one that is not immediately obvious.

words.ex: The displacement of the car was 10 meters east.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的位移是向东10米。
words.en: The act of moving something from its place or position, or the condition of having been moved from it.

words.tr: adv. 公开地；毫不隐瞒地；坦率地；
words.ex: He openly admitted his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他公开承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you do something openly, you do it without hiding any facts or hiding your feelings.

words.ex: The gross income of the company is $5 million.
words.ex_cn: 公司的总收入是500万美元。
words.en: If you describe something as gross, you mean it is very obvious, unacceptable, or unpleasant.

words.tr: n. 娱乐；消遣；休闲活动
words.ex: Reading books is his favorite recreation.
words.ex_cn: 读书是他最喜欢的消遣。
words.en: Recreation is activity that you do for enjoyment or amusement when you are not working.

words.ex: The detective tried to ascertain the truth.
words.ex_cn: 侦探试图查明真相。
words.en: If you ascertain the truth about something, you find out what it is, especially by making a deliberate effort to do so.

words.tr: v. 反映；反射；反省；思考；仔细考虑；
words.ex: The mirror reflects the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 镜子反射阳光。
words.en: If a surface reflects light, heat, sound, or an image, it sends the light, etc. back and does not absorb it. If something is reflected in a mirror or in water, you can see its image in the mirror or in the water.

words.ex: The measurement of temperature is important in science.
words.ex_cn: 温度的衡量在科学中很重要。
words.en: The action of measuring something.

words.ex: Water is a common substance.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的物质。
words.en: A substance is a particular kind of matter with uniform properties.

words.ex: The test results confirm he has the disease.
words.ex_cn: 检测结果证实他患有这种疾病。
words.en: To confirm something means to establish its truth or validity by providing evidence or proof.

words.ex: Plants use chlorophyll to make food from sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 植物利用叶绿素利用阳光制造食物。
words.en: Chlorophyll is a green pigment found in plants and algae that is essential for photosynthesis, the process by which light energy is converted into chemical energy.

words.ex: He made a hypothesis that plants grow faster in light.
words.ex_cn: 他提出一个假设，认为植物在光照下长得更快。
words.en: A hypothesis is an idea which is suggested as a possible explanation for a particular situation or condition, but which has not yet been proved to be correct.

words.ex: He vividly described the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他鲜明地描述了日落。
words.en: In a way that produces powerful feelings or strong, clear images in the mind.

words.ex: The pigment in leaves changes color in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 叶子中的色素在秋天会变色。
words.en: A pigment is a substance that gives something a particular color.

words.ex: The forest has abundant water and trees.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林水源和树木都很丰富。
words.en: If something is abundant, there is a lot of it or it is very common.

words.ex: We work during the daytime and rest at night.
words.ex_cn: 我们在白天工作，晚上休息。
words.en: The period of the day when there is natural light, from sunrise to sunset.

words.ex: The intensity of the sunlight made me wear sunglasses.
words.ex_cn: 阳光的强度让我戴上了太阳镜。
words.en: The quality of being intense, especially in terms of concentration, power, or force.

words.ex: The conifer stays green all year.
words.ex_cn: 针叶树全年都是绿色的。
words.en: A conifer is a type of tree that produces cones and needle-like or scale-like leaves. Conifers are often evergreen and include pines, spruces, firs, and cedars.

words.ex: The deer is herbivorous.
words.ex_cn: 这只鹿是食草的。
words.en: Herbivorous animals are those that feed on plants.

words.ex: Blueberries contain many anthocyanins.
words.ex_cn: 蓝莓含有许多花青素。
words.en: Anthocyanins are a type of flavonoid pigment found in plants, responsible for the red, purple, and blue colors in many fruits, flowers, and leaves. They have antioxidant properties and are studied for their potential health benefits.

words.tr: phrase. 埋葬地；墓地；安葬场所
words.ex: Archaeologists found a burial site near the river.
words.ex_cn: 考古学家在河边发现了一个墓地。
words.en: A burial site is a place where a dead body is buried.

words.ex: He comes from a seafaring family.
words.ex_cn: 他来自一个航海世家。
words.en: Seafaring relates to travelling by sea, especially as a job or as a way of life.

words.ex: He accidentally dropped his phone on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心把手机掉在地上了。
words.en: If something happens accidentally, it happens by chance or without being planned.

words.ex: The old cemetery is near the church.
words.ex_cn: 那个古老的墓地在教堂附近。
words.en: A cemetery is a place where dead people are buried.

words.ex: Britain colonised many parts of Africa.
words.ex_cn: 英国在非洲许多地区建立了殖民地。
words.en: To colonise means to send people to live in and govern another country, or to take control of an area and send people to live there.

words.ex: They went on a long voyage across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了一次横跨海洋的长途航行。
words.en: A voyage is a long journey, especially by sea or in space.

words.ex: The burial took place at sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 埋葬在日出时进行。
words.en: The act or ceremony of putting a dead body into a grave.

words.ex: The excavation revealed ancient pottery.
words.ex_cn: 挖掘发现了古代陶器。
words.en: The process of digging up and removing earth, especially at an archaeological site.

words.tr:
prep. 在（或向）…内；
n. 内部；里面；
adv. 在（或向）里面；
adj. 内部的；里面的；
words.ex: The keys are inside the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙在抽屉里。
words.en: The inside of something is the part that is normally enclosed or hidden by its outer surface.

words.ex: The math teacher asked for a proof of the theorem.
words.ex_cn: 数学老师要求给出这个定理的证明。
words.en: Proof is a fact, argument, or piece of evidence which shows that something is definitely true or definitely exists.

words.ex: The farmer worked on the plantation every day.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天在耕地上劳作。
words.en: A plantation is a large piece of land, especially in a tropical country, where crops such as coffee, sugar, rubber, or tobacco are grown.

words.tr:
n. 海港；
v. 庇护；窝藏；
words.ex: The ship docked at the harbour at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 船在日落时停靠在海港。
words.en: A harbour is an area of water next to the coast where ships and boats can shelter.

words.tr: phrase. 葬礼用的骨灰瓮；安放死者骨灰的容器
words.ex: They placed the ashes in a burial urn.
words.ex_cn: 他们把骨灰放在了一个骨灰瓮里。
words.en: A container, typically made of ceramic, metal, or stone, used to hold the ashes of a cremated person.

words.ex: The police found a clue at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了一条线索。
words.en: A clue is an object or piece of information that helps to solve a problem or mystery.

words.ex: He will alter the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会改动计划。
words.en: To alter something means to change it, usually slightly, or to cause the characteristics of something to change.

words.ex: She has an extraordinary talent for music.
words.ex_cn: 她具有非凡的音乐天赋。
words.en: Something that is extraordinary is very unusual or remarkable.

words.ex: The bridge can withstand strong winds.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥能经受住强风。
words.en: If something or someone withstands a force or action, they survive it or do not give in to it.

words.tr: phrase. 助航设备；导航辅助设施；航行辅助工具
words.ex: The lighthouse is a navigational aid for ships.
words.ex_cn: 灯塔是船只的导航辅助工具。
words.en: A navigational aid is any sort of marker which aids the traveler in navigation; the term is most commonly used to refer to nautical or aviation travel.

words.ex: I can detect a change in her mood.
words.ex_cn: 我能察觉到她情绪的变化。
words.en: To detect something means to find it or discover it, often using special equipment or methods.

words.tr: adj. 适合居住的；可居住的；
words.ex: The planet is habitable because it has water and air.
words.ex_cn: 这颗行星有水和空气，适合居住。
words.en: A place that is habitable is suitable or good enough for people to live in.

words.tr: phrase. 盛行风；主导风；某一地区在特定季节最常出现的风向
words.ex: The prevailing wind blows from the north.
words.ex_cn: 主导风从北方吹来。
words.en: A prevailing wind is a wind that blows predominantly from a particular direction over a particular area.

words.ex: The duration of the movie is two hours.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的持续时间是两小时。
words.en: The duration of an event or state is the time during which it happens or exists.

words.tr:
v. 中断；暂停；
n. 停顿下来；
words.ex: The storm halted the flight.
words.ex_cn: 风暴中断了航班。
words.en: to bring or come to a stop; a temporary or permanent stop

words.ex: The city's expansion caused more traffic.
words.ex_cn: 城市的扩张导致了更多的交通拥堵。
words.en: Expansion refers to the process of becoming larger or more extensive.

words.ex: The weather changed unpredictably.
words.ex_cn: 天气不可预测地变化了。
words.en: In a manner that cannot be predicted.

words.ex: Children are vulnerable to colds in winter.
words.ex_cn: 儿童在冬天容易感冒。
words.en: If someone or something is vulnerable, they are weak and without protection, with the result that they are easily hurt physically or emotionally.

words.ex: The noise will diminish after midnight.
words.ex_cn: 午夜后噪音会减少。
words.en: If something diminishes, or if something diminishes it, it becomes reduced in size, importance, or intensity.

words.tr: n. 进展；进步；缓慢前进；稳步前进；
words.ex: The project shows slow progress.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目进展缓慢。
words.en: Progress is the process of gradually improving or getting nearer to achieving or completing something.

words.tr: n. 代表大会；议会；国会；
words.ex: The congress met to discuss new laws.
words.ex_cn: 代表大会召开以讨论新法律。
words.en: A congress is a formal meeting of representatives, as of various nations, to discuss problems or to make decisions.

words.tr: v. 处理不当；使用不当
words.ex: He mishandled the situation and made it worse.
words.ex_cn: 他处理不当，让情况变得更糟。
words.en: If you mishandle something, you deal with it badly or carelessly, often causing problems or damage.

words.ex: The containment of the fire took three hours.
words.ex_cn: 控制火势花了三个小时。
words.en: The act of keeping something harmful under control or within limits.

words.ex: He works as a firefighter and loves firefighting.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名消防员，热爱消防工作。
words.en: The activity or profession of extinguishing fires.

words.ex: He has the capacity to solve hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: The capacity of a place or container is the amount of things or people that it can hold.

words.ex: He has the ability to solve math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力快速解决数学问题。
words.en: The capacity to do something or the possession of the means or skill to do something.

words.ex: He showed great capability in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题上展现了很强的能力。
words.en: The ability or qualities necessary to do something.

words.tr: adj. 惯常的；习惯性的；经常的；
words.ex: He is a habitual smoker.
words.ex_cn: 他是个惯常的吸烟者。
words.en: A habitual action, state, or way of behaving is one that someone usually does or has, especially one that is considered to be typical or characteristic of them.

words.ex: He acquired a new skill last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了一项新技能。
words.en: If you acquire something, you buy or obtain it for yourself, or someone gives it to you.

words.ex: He actively participates in class discussions.
words.ex_cn: 他积极参加课堂讨论。
words.en: In a way that involves positive action or participation.

words.ex: His shyness made it hard to speak in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他的害羞让他难以在全班面前说话。
words.en: Shyness is the feeling of being nervous or embarrassed in social situations, especially when meeting new people.

words.tr: v. 重新思考；重新考虑；
words.ex: We need to rethink our plan.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要重新思考我们的计划。
words.en: To consider again, especially with a view to changing or altering.

words.tr: adj. 被修改的；经过改变的
words.ex: He modified the recipe to make it healthier.
words.ex_cn: 他修改了食谱，使其更健康。
words.en: Changed or altered from an original form or version.

words.tr: phrase. 进化上的返祖现象；指生物体出现祖先特征的现象
words.ex: Some animals look like evolutionary throwbacks because they have old features.
words.ex_cn: 一些动物看起来像进化上的倒退，因为它们具有古老的特征。
words.en: Evolutionary throwbacks refer to instances where an organism exhibits traits of its ancestors, which are not seen in the immediate predecessors, often considered as reversals in the evolutionary process.

words.ex: The humpback swam near the shore.
words.ex_cn: 座头鲸游到了岸边附近。
words.en: A humpback is a large whale with a hump on its back and long flippers, known for its complex songs and acrobatic displays.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；例证；例示
words.ex: This example exemplifies the rule clearly.
words.ex_cn: 这个例子清楚地说明了这条规则。
words.en: To exemplify means to be a typical example of something or to give an example of something.

words.ex: There was a controversy about the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 关于新校规，人们展开了争论。
words.en: A controversy is a disagreement or argument about something that involves many people and generates strong feelings.

words.tr: phrase. 沉默基因；指在特定条件下不表达或不活跃的基因
words.ex: Silent genes can be activated under certain conditions.
words.ex_cn: 沉默基因在特定条件下可以被激活。
words.en: Silent genes refer to genes that are not expressed or are expressed at very low levels under normal conditions, but can be activated under certain circumstances.

words.ex: The reemergence of the old virus surprised scientists.
words.ex_cn: 这种旧病毒的重新出现让科学家们感到惊讶。
words.en: The act of appearing again or returning after a period of absence.

words.tr:
n. 时距；跨度；
v. 跨越；
words.ex: The span of his career was 40 years.
words.ex_cn: 他职业生涯的时距是40年。
words.en: The extent or measure of space between two points or extremities, as of a bridge or a roof; the full extent, stretch, or reach of anything.

words.ex: The mole dug a tunnel under the garden.
words.ex_cn: 鼹鼠在花园下挖了一条隧道。
words.en: A mole is a small animal with black fur that lives underground. It can also refer to a small dark spot on the skin or a person who secretly gives information to an enemy.

words.ex: The salamander crawled under a wet leaf.
words.ex_cn: 蝾螈爬到了一片湿叶子下面。
words.en: A salamander is a small animal that looks like a lizard and lives both on land and in water. Salamanders are amphibians, which means they can live both in water and on land.

words.ex: He regained his strength after rest.
words.ex_cn: 他休息后恢复了体力。
words.en: If you regain something that you have lost, you get it back again.

words.ex: The frog is an amphibian.
words.ex_cn: 青蛙是一种两栖动物。
words.en: An amphibian is a type of animal that can live both on land and in water. Frogs, toads, and salamanders are examples of amphibians.

words.ex: The lizard sits on the rock in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 蜥蜴趴在阳光下的石头上。
words.en: A lizard is a reptile with a long body, four legs, a long tail, and rough, scaly skin.

words.ex: His assertion was simple: the project will finish on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的断言很简单：项目会按时完成。
words.en: A statement that is made with confidence but without proof.

words.ex: He rejected the job offer.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝了那份工作。
words.en: Refused to accept or consider something.

words.ex: He opposes the new law.
words.ex_cn: 他反对这项新法律。
words.en: If you oppose someone or something, you disagree with them and try to prevent them from doing something, or you try to change what they are doing.

words.ex: A shark swam near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 一条鲨鱼在海滩附近游动。
words.en: A shark is a large fish that lives in the sea and has very sharp teeth.

words.tr: phrase. 失落已久的特质；久违的性格特征
words.ex: Scientists are trying to revive the long-lost traits of ancient plants.
words.ex_cn: 科学家们正试图恢复古代植物的长期遗失的特征。
words.en: Characteristics or features that have been missing or forgotten for a long time.

words.ex: The sun reappeared after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴过后，太阳重新出现了。
words.en: If someone or something reappears, they appear again after they have been away or out of sight for some time.

words.ex: The occurrence of rain surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 下雨这件事让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: An occurrence is something that happens or takes place.

words.tr:
adj. 平行的；
n. 类似的事物；
words.ex: The two lines are parallel and never meet.
words.ex_cn: 这两条线是平行的，永远不会相交。
words.en: Something that is parallel to something else is similar to it in many ways, or happens at the same time as it.

words.ex: The change is reversible under normal conditions.
words.ex_cn: 在正常条件下，这种变化是可逆的。
words.en: Capable of being reversed; able to return to an original state or condition.

words.ex: His conviction that honesty is important never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他坚信诚实很重要，从未改变。
words.en: A conviction is a strong belief or opinion, or the state of being found guilty of a crime in a court of law.

words.tr:
n. 脚趾
v. 用脚尖触
words.ex: He touched the ball with his toe.
words.ex_cn: 他用脚趾碰了球。
words.en: One of the five digits at the end of the foot, or the similar part of a shoe or sock.

words.ex: She wore toeless socks to match her sandals.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了无趾袜来搭配她的凉鞋。
words.en: adj. lacking toes; without toes

words.ex: Scientists study embryos to understand how life begins.
words.ex_cn: 科学家研究胚胎以了解生命是如何开始的。
words.en: An embryo is an unborn or unhatched offspring in the process of development, especially in the early stages.

words.ex: He took a temporary job during summer.
words.ex_cn: 他在暑假期间做了一份短暂的工作。
words.en: Something that is temporary lasts for only a limited time.

words.ex: The baby grows in the mother's womb.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿在母亲的子宫里成长。
words.en: The organ in the lower body of a woman or female mammal where offspring are conceived and in which they gestate before birth.

words.ex: We stayed indoors because it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 因为下雨，我们待在室内。
words.en: If you are indoors, you are inside a building.

words.ex: The tree grows in a vertical line.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树垂直生长。
words.en: Something that is vertical stands or points straight up.

words.ex: Methane is a gas that comes from cows and landfills.
words.ex_cn: 甲烷是一种来自牛和垃圾填埋场的气体。
words.en: A colorless, odorless flammable gas which is the main constituent of natural gas. It is the simplest member of the alkane series of hydrocarbons.

words.ex: It is probable that he will come tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天来的可能性很大。
words.en: If you say that something is probable, you mean that it is likely to be true or likely to happen.

words.tr: adj. 传染性的；有感染力的；
words.ex: The virus is infectious and spreads quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒具有传染性，传播迅速。
words.en: An infectious disease can be passed from one person to another, especially through the air they breathe.

words.ex: Initially, he didn't like the job.
words.ex_cn: 最初，他不喜欢这份工作。
words.en: At the beginning; at first.

words.tr: n. 吊船工作台；狭长小船( gondola的名词复数 )；
words.ex: The workers stand on gondolas to clean the tall building.
words.ex_cn: 工人们站在吊船工作台上清洁高楼。
words.en: A gondola is a traditional, flat-bottomed Venetian rowing boat, well suited to the conditions of the Venetian lagoon.

words.ex: The mechanic tightened the bolt with a wrench.
words.ex_cn: 机械师用扳手拧紧了螺栓。
words.en: A bolt is a type of fastener consisting of a threaded pin or rod with a head at one end, designed to be inserted through holes in assembled parts and tightened by a nut from the other end. It can also refer to a sudden dash or run, or to eat food quickly and without chewing.

words.ex: His presence made everyone feel calm.
words.ex_cn: 他的存在让每个人都感到平静。
words.en: The state or fact of existing, occurring, or being present in a place or thing.

words.tr: phrase. 运河港湾；运河码头区（指运河末端供船只停靠、装卸货物的水域区域）
words.ex: The canal basin was bustling with boats and people.
words.ex_cn: n. 运河盆地热闹非凡，到处都是船只和人群。
words.en: A canal basin is a wide area of water where canals meet and boats can be moored.

words.ex: The wheel rotates slowly.
words.ex_cn: 轮子缓慢地转动。
words.en: To rotate means to turn or cause to turn around an axis or center.

words.tr: phrase. 在……下方挖掘隧道；从……底下穿过
words.ex: The miners decided to tunnel beneath the mountain to find coal.
words.ex_cn: 矿工们决定在山下挖隧道以寻找煤炭。
words.en: To dig or construct a tunnel underneath something.

words.tr:
adj. 竖直的；直立的；
adv. 笔直地；
words.ex: The picture is hanging upright on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画垂直地挂在墙上。
words.en: If you are sitting or standing upright, you are sitting or standing with your back straight, rather than bending or lying down.

words.tr:
v. 提到；说到；
n. 提及；说起；
words.ex: He didn't mention the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他没有提到那场事故。
words.en: If you mention something, you say something about it, usually briefly.

words.ex: Geoengineering may help reduce global warming.
words.ex_cn: 地质工程可能有助于减缓全球变暖。
words.en: Geoengineering refers to the deliberate large-scale intervention in the Earth's natural systems to counteract climate change.

words.tr: adj. 极小的；微小的；微量的；
words.ex: The tiny ant carried a big leaf.
words.ex_cn: 这只极小的蚂蚁搬着一片大叶子。
words.en: Very small in size or amount.

words.tr: phrase. 气溶胶喷雾；喷雾剂（指将液体压缩成细小颗粒通过喷嘴喷出的装置，常用于清洁剂、香水、杀虫剂等）
words.ex: He uses aerosol sprays to clean his keyboard.
words.ex_cn: 他使用气溶胶喷雾来清洁键盘。
words.en: A suspension of fine solid or liquid particles in gas, often used in sprays for various applications.

words.tr: n. 平流层；同温层；最高层；
words.ex: Planes fly in the stratosphere to avoid bad weather.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在平流层飞行以避开恶劣天气。
words.en: The stratosphere is the second major layer of Earth's atmosphere, just above the troposphere, and below the mesosphere. It is characterized by a slight temperature increase with altitude and the presence of the ozone layer, which absorbs and scatters the solar ultraviolet radiation.

words.tr:
n. 北极地区；
adj. 北极的；
words.ex: Polar bears live in the arctic.
words.ex_cn: 北极熊生活在北极地区。
words.en: The Arctic is the area around the Earth's North Pole, characterized by cold temperatures and ice.

words.tr: v. 反映；反射；反省；思考；仔细考虑；
words.ex: The mirror reflects the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 镜子反射阳光。
words.en: If a surface reflects light, heat, sound, or an image, it sends the light, etc. back and does not absorb it. If something is reflected in a mirror or in water, you can see its image in the mirror or in the water.

words.ex: The sun gives off radiation.
words.ex_cn: 太阳发出辐射。
words.en: Radiation is energy that comes from a source and travels through space at the speed of light. This energy has an electric field and a magnetic field associated with it, and has wave-like properties. You could also call radiation 'electromagnetic waves'.

words.tr: adj. 持久的；持续的；长期的
words.ex: This paint is long-lasting and doesn't fade easily.
words.ex_cn: 这种油漆持久不褪色。
words.en: Something that is long-lasting continues to exist or have an effect for a long time.

words.tr:
n. 洗涤槽；水槽；
v. （使）沉没；
words.ex: The dirty dishes are in the sink.
words.ex_cn: 脏盘子在水槽里。
words.en: If a boat sinks, or if something sinks it, it disappears below the surface of a mass of water.

words.tr:
v. 相配；
n. 比赛；
words.ex: The curtains match the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 窗帘和沙发相配。
words.en: A match is a competition or game in which people or teams compete against each other. It can also refer to a small stick that produces a flame when rubbed against a rough surface, used for lighting a fire, cigarette, etc. Additionally, it can mean a person or thing that is equal to another in quality, strength, or suitability.

words.ex: The hull of the boat was damaged by the rocks.
words.ex_cn: 船的船体被岩石损坏了。
words.en: The main body of a ship or other vessel, including the bottom, sides, and deck but not the masts, superstructure, rigging, engines, and other fittings.

words.tr: adj. 无可置辩的；无异议的；
words.ex: He is the undisputed champion of the tournament.
words.ex_cn: 他是这场比赛无可置辩的冠军。
words.en: If you describe a fact or opinion as undisputed, you mean that it is accepted as true or correct by everyone.

words.tr: n. 摩艾石像（复活节岛上的巨大石像）
words.ex: The moai statues on Easter Island are a mystery to archaeologists.
words.ex_cn: 复活节岛上的摩艾石像对考古学家来说是一个谜。
words.en: The moai are monolithic human figures carved by the Rapa Nui people on Easter Island between 1250 and 1500 CE. They are believed to represent the spirits of ancestors or important figures in the community.

words.ex: The noise will diminish after midnight.
words.ex_cn: 午夜后噪音会减少。
words.en: If something diminishes, or if something diminishes it, it becomes reduced in size, importance, or intensity.

words.ex: She wore a diamond ring on her finger.
words.ex_cn: 她手指上戴着一枚钻石戒指。
words.en: A diamond is a precious stone consisting of a clear and colorless crystalline form of pure carbon, the hardest naturally occurring substance.

words.ex: Bees collect pollen from flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂从花朵中采集花粉。
words.en: Pollen is a fine powder produced by flowers, which is carried by the wind or insects to other flowers of the same species, causing them to produce seeds.

words.ex: The palm tree grows near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 棕榈树长在海滩附近。
words.en: The inner surface of the hand that extends from the wrist to the base of the fingers; also refers to the tropical tree with large divided leaves.

words.ex: The chieftain led his tribe to find new land.
words.ex_cn: 酋长带领他的部落寻找新的土地。
words.en: A chieftain is the leader of a tribe or clan.

words.ex: He carved the meat with a sharp knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用一把锋利的刀切开了肉。
words.en: To carve means to cut into a hard material in order to produce an object, design, or inscription.

words.ex: The software uses advanced algorithms for shape-matching to identify objects in images.
words.ex_cn: 该软件使用先进的形状匹配算法来识别图像中的物体。
words.en: The process of comparing the shapes of two or more objects to determine how similar they are.

words.ex: He showed appreciation for her hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他对她的辛勤工作表示欣赏。
words.en: Recognition of the quality, value, significance, or magnitude of people and things.

words.ex: Children have reliance on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子依赖父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: Reliance is the state of depending on or trusting in someone or something.

words.ex: There is a tendency for people to use phones before bed.
words.ex_cn: 人们在睡觉前使用手机是一种趋势。
words.en: A tendency is a likelihood of behaving in a particular way or going in a particular direction, which is often bad or undesirable.

words.ex: The dark clouds indicate rain.
words.ex_cn: 乌云表明要下雨了。
words.en: If one thing indicates another, the first thing shows that the second is true or exists.

words.ex: He misleads his friends with false stories.
words.ex_cn: 他用虚假的故事误导他的朋友。
words.en: If you say that someone has misled you, you mean that they have made you believe something which is not true, either by telling you a lie or by giving you a wrong idea or impression.

words.tr:
adj. 最初的；开始的；
n. 首字母；
words.ex: This is the initial plan for the project.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个项目的最初计划。
words.en: The first letter of a name or word, used to represent the whole name or word.

words.ex: I perceive a change in his mood.
words.ex_cn: 我察觉到他的情绪有变化。
words.en: If you perceive something, you see, notice, or realize it, especially when it is not obvious.

words.ex: The painting is representational and shows a clear tree.
